changelog.summary: Initial research of all 10 cards from issuer terms, guides to benefits and official pages.

2026-Q4 refresh of all 10 cards. Bilt: World of Hyatt transfers drop from 1:1 to 4:3 on 2027-01-01 (announced 2026-10-01); Grubhub Bilt Cash now issued as expiring promo cards. Chase Freedom Unlimited: points combined into a pre-June-15-2026 Sapphire Preferred now transfer to Hyatt at 4:3 (since 2026-10-01). Amex Platinum: Lufthansa lounge access ended 2026-10-01; Resy credit needs the 'Resy Credit eligible' badge (since 2026-08-01) and badged U.S. Tock venues count (since 2026-09-15); Global Entry/TSA credit corrected to one per Additional Card as well; credit fine print expanded. Amex Gold: same Resy badge/Tock rules, Hotel Collection credit terms from Amex Travel, Uber One credit conditions. Discover: Q4 2026 confirmed (restaurants, entertainment, utilities) with streaming excluded; Q1 2027 not yet announced; Capital One migration waves noted. Wells Fargo: rewards pooling note corrected (manual moves between own cards still allowed). Apple Card: still Goldman, Chase transition not closed; Apple Upgrade lease payments earn 3%. Prime Visa: no changes; noted it is excluded from Chase's DashPass and Lyft partner benefits. Marriott Boundless and Blue Cash Preferred: no changes. Issuer sites were blocked by the network proxy this run, so checks relied on official text in search results; see Needs manual check.

amex-mr.name: Amex Membership Rewards
amex-mr.note: 1¢ on Amex Travel flights, 0.6¢ statement credit, often 1.5–2¢ via airline transfers

chase-ur.name: Chase Ultimate Rewards (Freedom Unlimited)
chase-ur.note: 1¢ cash. Combining into your wife's Sapphire Preferred now gives Points Boost (1–1.75¢ on select bookings) or 1:1 transfers, not a flat 1.25¢

wf-rewards.name: Wells Fargo Rewards
wf-rewards.note: 1¢ cash; 1:1 to Flying Blue, Avios, JetBlue, Cathay, Virgin, Avianca; 1:2 Choice/Wyndham

bilt-points.name: Bilt Points
bilt-points.note: 1:1 to Hyatt, United, Alaska, Aeroplan, Flying Blue, Virgin, JAL and more (not American)

bilt-cash.name: Bilt Cash (per $1)
bilt-cash.note: worth $1 only on Bilt credits you'd use anyway (Lyft/Walgreens/Grubhub $10/mo each, Bilt Travel hotels, dining, fitness); converting to rent points costs $3 per 100 pts. Set this to what $1 of Bilt Cash is really worth to you

cards.name: The Platinum Card from American Express

currency.name: Membership Rewards
currency.redemption: Points do not expire while at least one MR-earning card stays open. Best fixed-value use is Pay with Points for flights booked through Amex Travel (amextravel.com / Amex Travel app / Platinum Travel Service) at 1.0 cent per point (100 points = $1; 5,000-point minimum; Platinum Member Airfares fares can be paid with points and prepaid FHR/THC bookings paid with points still trigger the hotel credit). Prepaid hotels, car rentals, cruises and vacation packages via Amex Travel run about 0.7 cpp; statement credits ('Cover Your Card Charges') about 0.6 cpp; gift cards roughly 0.5-1.0 cpp; Amazon/PayPal checkout about 0.7 cpp. Highest value is transferring to 20 travel partners (16 airlines + 4 hotels), most at 1:1 (minimum transfer 1,000 points, 250 for JetBlue, 500 for Qantas): Aer Lingus AerClub 1:1, Aeromexico Rewards 1:1.6, Air Canada Aeroplan 1:1, Air France-KLM Flying Blue 1:1, ANA Mileage Club 1:1, Avianca LifeMiles 1:1, British Airways Club 1:1, Cathay Pacific 5:4 (1,000 MR = 800), Delta SkyMiles 1:1, Emirates Skywards 5:4, Iberia Club 1:1, JetBlue TrueBlue 1:0.8 (250 MR = 200), Qantas Frequent Flyer 1:1, Qatar Privilege Club 1:1, Singapore KrisFlyer 1:1, Virgin Atlantic Flying Club 1:1; hotels: Choice Privileges 1:1, Hilton Honors 1:2, Marriott Bonvoy 1:1, Leading Hotels of the World Leaders Club 4:1 (added July 28, 2026). Etihad Guest was removed as a partner June 30, 2026. Transfers to U.S.-based airline programs (Delta, JetBlue) incur an excise-tax offset fee of $0.0006 per point, capped at $99 per transfer. Most transfers are instant; ANA can take ~48 hours and Leaders Club ~72 hours. Amex Travel redemption rates and transfer ratios are from The Points Guy (Aug 20, 2026) and Upgraded Points (Aug 21, 2026); the official Pay with Points page confirms eligible purchases and the 5,000-point minimum but does not publish cpp values.
currency.verificationNotes: Official card page confirms 5X/1X earning, Pay with Points for flights/prepaid hotels on AmexTravel.com, gift cards, and 'transfer points to 20 airline and hotel travel partners.' Official Pay with Points page confirms 5,000-point minimum and that only prepaid hotels/cars qualify. Cents-per-point values, individual partner ratios, the excise fee and the Etihad/Leaders Club changes were confirmed only from TPG and Upgraded Points (secondary) because the logged-in MR terms pages could not be fetched.

earning.conditions: Airfare purchased directly from airlines (airline website, app, ticket counter, phone) or through American Express Travel (amextravel.com, Amex Travel app, Platinum Travel Service). Cap is $500,000 in flight purchases per calendar year, then 1X.
earning.notes: Official wording: '5X Membership Rewards points on flights purchased directly from airlines or American Express Travel on up to $500,000 on these purchases per calendar year.' Flights bought through other online travel agencies (Expedia, Priceline, Chase Travel, etc.) or bundled in vacation packages do not earn 5X. Incidental fees charged by the airline (bags, seats, lounge passes) are generally not 'airfare' and typically post at 1X. Platinum Member Airfares (discounted fares sold only via Amex Travel) earn 5X.

earning.conditions: Prepaid hotel bookings made through American Express Travel only (amextravel.com or Amex Travel app), including Fine Hotels + Resorts and The Hotel Collection. Pay-later / pay-at-hotel bookings, prepaid car rentals, cruises and vacation packages through Amex Travel earn 1X.
earning.notes: Official wording: '5X Membership Rewards points on prepaid hotels booked on AmexTravel.com.' No published cap. Hotels booked directly with the hotel brand earn 1X (there is no direct-hotel bonus category on this card). Prepaid FHR/THC bookings paid with the card also trigger the semiannual hotel credit.

earning.conditions: All other eligible purchases.
earning.notes: 1X on everything else including dining, groceries, gas, hotels booked direct, car rentals, and Uber. Standard MR exclusions apply (cash equivalents, fees, interest, person-to-person payments, gift cards may be treated as cash equivalents). This is a weak everyday earner; the card's value is in credits and perks, not spend.

credits.name: $600 Hotel Credit (Fine Hotels + Resorts / The Hotel Collection)
credits.schedule: Up to $300 in statement credits Jan 1-Jun 30 and up to $300 Jul 1-Dec 31 (calendar halves); up to $600 per calendar year. Unused half-year amounts do not roll over.
credits.howToUse: Book a PREPAID Fine Hotels + Resorts stay (any length) or a PREPAID Hotel Collection stay of 2+ nights on amextravel.com / Amex Travel app / Platinum Travel Service and pay with the Platinum Card (Pay with Points bookings still qualify). 'Pay Later' / 'Pay at Hotel' bookings do not qualify. Credit is based on the charge date, so a stay booked and charged in June counts against Jan-Jun even if the stay is in August. Multiple bookings can add up to the $300. Refunds/cancellations/modifications can reverse the credit. Allow up to 90 days to post (usually a few days). Statement shows 'AMEX FINE HOTELS RES' or 'AMEX HOTEL COLLECTN'. FHR bookings also carry daily breakfast for two, room upgrade when available, $100 on-property credit, noon check-in when available and guaranteed 4 PM checkout; THC gives the $100 credit, upgrade and 4 PM late checkout when available.

credits.name: Airline fee credit (United selected; incidentals, not airfare)
credits.schedule: Resets January 1; up to $200 per calendar year; does not roll over.
credits.howToUse: Select ONE qualifying airline in the Amex account (this cardholder: United) before the fee charges post; the selection can be changed only in January each year (or once via phone), otherwise last year's choice carries forward. Official qualifying fees: checked-bag and overweight/oversize bag fees, seat selection, in-flight food/beverage and entertainment (not Wi-Fi), flight-change fees, airport lounge day passes and annual club memberships, pet-kennel/in-cabin pet fees, phone reservation fees. Officially EXCLUDED: airfare, upgrades, mileage purchases/transfer fees, gift cards, duty-free, award tickets. United data points (2026): Economy Plus seat purchases, United Club day passes/memberships, checked bags, seat selection, pet fees, same-day change fees reliably post; United TravelBank loads STOPPED triggering the credit around Feb 2026 and award-ticket close-in/redeposit fees stopped around July 2026 per Upgraded Points. Amex relies on airline transaction coding; credit usually posts in days, officially allow 6-8 weeks. Both Basic and Additional Card charges on the selected airline count toward the same $200.

credits.name: Uber Cash
credits.schedule: $15 Uber Cash loaded each month plus a $20 bonus in December ($35 in December); up to $200 per calendar year. Each month's Uber Cash expires at 11:59 PM HST on the last day of that month.
credits.howToUse: Add the Platinum Card as a payment method in the Uber / Uber Eats app (this is the 'enrollment'); Uber Cash appears automatically each month. To use it, select an American Express card as the payment method for the ride/order and have Uber Cash toggled ON. Works only for rides and orders in the U.S.; not for Uber gift cards, and Uber Cash cannot be used for the Uber One membership fee if you want the Uber One credit. Delivered as Uber Cash in the app, not a statement credit. Per the official benefit terms, Additional Card Members are not eligible for Platinum Uber Cash (Basic Card Member only).

credits.name: Uber One Membership Credit
credits.schedule: Statement credits for auto-renewing Uber One membership charges, up to $120 per calendar year per Card Account (effectively covers the $9.99/month plan; an annual $96 plan is also reimbursed).
credits.howToUse: Purchase an auto-renewing Uber One membership in the U.S. with the Platinum Card as the payment method. In the app, turn Uber Cash OFF for the membership fee so the fee is charged to the Amex card (if Uber Cash pays it, no statement credit). Credits post automatically, typically within a few days, up to 8 weeks. Uber One charges from Basic and Additional Card Members are eligible but share the $120 cap. New benefit added Sept 18, 2025.

credits.name: $400 Resy Credit
credits.schedule: Up to $100 per calendar quarter (Jan-Mar, Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec); up to $400 per calendar year. Unused quarterly amounts do not roll over.
credits.howToUse: Enroll once in the Amex account or app (allow up to 24 hours). Then pay with the Platinum Card at a qualifying U.S. restaurant or other food and beverage establishment (e.g. wineries, cafes) on Resy, or for purchases made directly on Resy.com / the Resy app or via Resy Pay; a Resy reservation is NOT required. Since Aug 1, 2026 the venue must be shown as eligible for the Resy Credit (a 'Resy Credit eligible' badge) on its Resy.com / Resy app page at the time of purchase, and the eligible list can change at any time. Since Sept 15, 2026 select U.S. Tock venues (Tock is being merged into Resy) that carry the badge also qualify. Excludes gift cards purchased at restaurants, merchandise, Resy-branded gift cards and restaurant software. The $100/quarter cap is shared across all Cards on the Account. Credits typically post within days, officially up to 8 weeks. New benefit added Sept 18, 2025.

credits.name: $300 Digital Entertainment Credit
credits.schedule: Up to $25 in statement credits per calendar month; up to $300 per calendar year. Unused monthly amounts do not roll over.
credits.howToUse: Enroll (Basic Card Member) in the Amex account and allow up to 24 hours, then pay for the subscription DIRECTLY with the partner using the Platinum Card: disneyplus.com (Disney+ or a Disney+ bundle), stream.ESPN.com (ESPN streaming subscriptions, add-ons and pay-per-view; not ESPN bundled with cable or bought through third parties), hulu.com, nytimes.com/subscription, paramountplus.com, peacocktv.com, wsj.com/amex, YouTube (Premium / TV). Subscriptions billed through Apple App Store, Google Play, Amazon, Roku or other third parties do NOT qualify. Effective Aug 1, 2026 Peacock bundled subscriptions (e.g. Peacock + Apple TV bundle), add-on services and third-party purchases are ineligible; standalone Peacock plans bought at peacocktv.com still qualify. Netflix, Max, Apple TV+, Prime Video, Spotify, Apple Music, Sling, Fubo are NOT eligible. Basic and Additional Card Member charges share the same $25 monthly cap per Card Account. Credit usually posts within days, up to 8 weeks.

credits.name: $300 lululemon Credit
credits.schedule: Up to $75 per calendar quarter; up to $300 per calendar year. Unused quarterly amounts do not roll over.
credits.howToUse: Enrollment by the Basic Card Member is required (allow up to 24 hours). Then pay with the Platinum Card directly with lululemon at a U.S. lululemon store, lululemon.com (U.S. site) or the lululemon app. Officially excluded: lululemon Studio, Like New, outlet locations, warehouse sales, event locations, showrooms and wholesale transactions, gift card purchases, orders shipped outside the U.S., non-U.S. stores and third-party retailers. Online orders are charged when they ship, so order early enough in the quarter for the charge to post before quarter end. Credit usually posts within days, officially up to 8 weeks. Returns can reverse the credit. New benefit added Sept 18, 2025.

credits.name: $200 Oura Ring Credit
credits.schedule: Up to $200 in statement credits per calendar year per Card Account; resets January 1.
credits.howToUse: Enrollment by the Basic Card Member is required; enroll in the Amex account first, then buy an Oura Ring at ouraring.com (U.S. site) with the Platinum Card, shipping to a U.S. address (not territories). Only ring hardware qualifies: the Oura membership/subscription (~$5.99/mo), chargers and other hardware add-ons, extended warranties, Oura gift cards, and purchases from Amazon/Best Buy/other third-party retailers do NOT qualify. Do not split payment via PayPal. Allow up to 8 weeks to post; returns/cancellations reverse the credit. The $200 is per account (shared with Additional Card Members) and does not require a subscription purchase. New benefit added Sept 18, 2025.

credits.name: $300 Equinox Credit
credits.schedule: Up to $300 in statement credits per calendar year; resets January 1.
credits.howToUse: The Basic Card Member must first validate the Card Account at https://platinum.equinox.com/ (or via the link in the Amex account benefits section) BEFORE paying, then the Basic or an Additional Card Member pays the auto-renewing Equinox club membership or Equinox+ digital subscription directly with Equinox/Equinox+ using the Platinum Card. Eligible club memberships per Amex: Single Club (U.S. only), Regional Access (U.S. only), All-Access, Destination Access and E by Equinox Access. Initiation fees, personal training, spa services, retail and Equinox Hotel charges do not qualify. $300 cap is per Card Account. Credit typically posts in a few days, up to 8 weeks. Since Jan 1, 2023 the credit is a single $300 annual pool rather than $25/month.

credits.name: Walmart+ Monthly Membership Credit
credits.schedule: Up to $12.95 plus applicable sales tax per month for one monthly Walmart+ membership (about $155 per calendar year).
credits.howToUse: Sign up for the MONTHLY (not annual) Walmart+ plan (Amex/Walmart partner page: walmart.com/plus/partnerenroll?programName=amexplatinum) and pay with any Card on the Platinum account; up to $12.95 + tax is credited each month. Only one Walmart+ monthly membership per Card Account per month; annual memberships, 'Plus Up' add-ons (e.g. Walmart InHome) and Walmart Business+ are excluded. Walmart+ includes Paramount+ Essential at no extra charge, plus free shipping/delivery and fuel discounts. Credit usually posts within days, up to 6-8 weeks. Amex's Credit Intel page describes this as automatic with card payment, while the benefit terms refer to the 'enrolled Basic Card Member' (Upgraded Points says Amex enrollment is required); enroll in the benefits dashboard if the option appears.

credits.name: $219 CLEAR+ Credit
credits.schedule: Up to $219 in statement credits per calendar year for CLEAR+ membership fees (excluding taxes/fees); increased from $209 to $219 effective July 1, 2026 to match CLEAR's price increase.
credits.howToUse: Sign up for or renew an auto-renewing CLEAR+ membership at clearme.com with the Platinum Card as the payment method (completing CLEAR's own enrollment at an airport CLEAR location; no separate Amex enrollment per the official fact sheet). The credit covers one adult membership ($219/yr list); added family members ($125 each) are not fully covered unless room remains under the cap. Children under 18 accompany a member free. Basic and Additional Card Member purchases are eligible but share $219 per Card Account per calendar year. Officially, no credit if paid through an electronic wallet or a third party (such as an app store) or if the merchant uses a mobile/wireless card reader. Credit posts within days, up to 6-8 weeks. CLEAR+ is separate from TSA PreCheck; pairing both is the fastest path through U.S. security.

credits.name: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Fee Credit
credits.schedule: One statement credit every 4 years for Global Entry ($120) OR every 4.5 years for a five-year TSA PreCheck membership (up to $85) - whichever you apply for and pay with the card.
credits.howToUse: Pay the Global Entry ($120) or TSA PreCheck (up to $85 for a five-year membership through an official TSA PreCheck enrollment provider such as IDEMIA, Telos, or CLEAR) application/renewal fee with the Platinum Card; the credit posts automatically, usually within days (up to 6-8 weeks), whether or not the application is approved. Global Entry includes TSA PreCheck, so it is the better choice. The fee can be for anyone (e.g., a family member). One credit per card per 4-year window (4.5 years for TSA PreCheck), whichever fee is charged first; per Amex, each Additional Platinum Card is also eligible for its own credit when the fee is charged on that Additional Card. Full terms at americanexpress.com/en-us/benefits/travel/expedite-your-travel/.

credits.name: American Express Venue Collection - 10% back on concessions
credits.schedule: 10% back as statement credits on qualifying concessions purchases at participating Venue Collection stadiums/arenas, up to $250 back per calendar year.
credits.howToUse: Enroll the Card in the Venue Collection benefit (limit one enrolled Card per Card Member), then pay for qualifying food/beverage concessions at participating venues with the enrolled Card; 10% posts as a statement credit up to $250 per calendar year. Venues also offer dedicated Amex entrances/fast lanes. Participating venue list is on americanexpress.com/entertainment.

rentalCar.limit: Up to $75,000 per rental agreement for damage to or theft of the rental vehicle (plus reasonable towing/loss-of-use charged by the rental company); also includes accidental death/dismemberment and some personal property/medical benefits per the guide
rentalCar.notes: Must reserve and pay for the ENTIRE rental with the Platinum Card and decline the rental company's collision damage waiver (CDW/LDW). Secondary to any personal auto insurance and other coverage; no liability coverage. Not available for vehicles rented in Australia, Italy, New Zealand or OFAC-sanctioned countries. Excluded vehicles include cargo vans, custom vans, trucks over certain weights, off-road vehicles, motorcycles/mopeds, RVs, antiques and exotic/certain high-value cars (see guide). Optional Premium Car Rental Protection (enroll once at americanexpress.com/pcrp, charged per rental, not per day): Basic $19.95 per rental ($12.25 FL, $15.95 CA) for up to $75,000 PRIMARY damage/theft coverage, or Plus $24.95 ($15.25 FL, $17.95 CA) for up to $100,000 primary coverage; each covers up to 42 consecutive days (30 in WA), no deductible, plus AD&D and secondary medical/personal-property benefits; same country exclusions plus Ireland, Israel and Jamaica.

purchaseProtection.notes: Covers theft, accidental damage, and loss of eligible purchases charged to the card for 90 days from purchase; up to $10,000 per covered purchase and $50,000 per Card Member account per calendar year. Must be charged (in full or partially, for the charged portion) to the card; exclusions include motorized vehicles, consumables, plants/animals, refurbished items not refurbished by manufacturer, items left in an unattended vehicle beyond limits, etc. Underwritten by AMEX Assurance Company. Platinum-specific guide: PP-Benefit-Guide_316-404.

extendedWarranty.notes: Adds up to one extra year to original manufacturer's warranties of 5 years or less on covered purchases charged to the card; coverage up to the amount charged, max $10,000 per item and $50,000 per Card Member account per calendar year. Begins after the manufacturer's warranty (and any purchased extended warranty) ends. Excludes motorized vehicles, consumables, used/pre-owned items unless manufacturer-refurbished, etc. Platinum-specific guide: EW-Benefit-Guide_314-399.

returnProtection.notes: If a U.S. merchant will not accept a return of an eligible item within 90 days of purchase, Amex may refund the full purchase price (excluding shipping/handling) up to $300 per item and $1,000 per Card Member account per calendar year. Item must be purchased entirely with the card in the U.S. or its territories, be in like-new condition, and may need to be shipped to Amex. Call 1-800-228-6855 within 90 days of purchase. Exclusions include perishables, jewelry, tickets, software, cars, etc.

cellPhone.conditions: The cell phone line must be listed on a wireless bill and the PRIOR month's wireless bill must have been paid with the Platinum Card (Basic or Additional Card on the account). Coverage starts the first day of the month after the first bill payment; a missed month suspends coverage the following month.
cellPhone.notes: Reimburses the lesser of repair or replacement cost for damaged or stolen phones, up to $800 per claim, max 2 approved claims per 12-month period, $50 deductible per claim. Covers cracked screens and theft (police report within 48 hours); excludes lost/mysteriously disappeared phones, cosmetic damage, prepaid/rented/borrowed phones, and losses covered by other insurance or warranty. Coverage by New Hampshire Insurance Company (AIG). Added to Platinum in 2021.

tripDelay.notes: Round trip must be paid entirely with the Platinum Card (points + card charges OK per Amex). Delays of more than 6 hours for a covered reason (weather, mechanical, terrorism, lost/stolen documents, etc.) reimburse reasonable additional expenses (meals, lodging, toiletries, transportation) purchased with the same card, up to $500 per covered trip, max 2 claims per Eligible Card per 12 consecutive months. Coverage by New Hampshire Insurance Company (AIG). Covers Card Member, spouse/domestic partner and dependent children under 23 on the same trip.

tripCancellation.notes: Round trip must be purchased entirely with the Platinum Card. Reimburses non-refundable prepaid expenses charged to the same card when a covered reason (illness/injury, severe weather, jury duty, terrorism, etc.) cancels or interrupts the trip, up to $10,000 per covered trip and $20,000 per Eligible Card per 12 consecutive months. Does not cover pre-existing conditions, change-of-mind, or financial default of a supplier. Coverage by New Hampshire Insurance Company (AIG).

baggageDelay.notes: Amex Platinum does not offer a baggage DELAY (reimbursement of essentials while bags are late) benefit; only lost/damaged/stolen baggage coverage via the Baggage Insurance Plan. Trip Delay may indirectly help with essentials only if the flight itself is delayed 6+ hours.

lostLuggage.notes: Baggage Insurance Plan (Platinum guide BIP 311-329): covers lost, damaged or stolen baggage on a common carrier trip whose fare is charged entirely to the card. Up to $2,000 per covered person for checked baggage and up to $3,000 for carry-on, with a combined maximum of $3,000 per covered person per trip; high-risk items (jewelry, electronics, cameras, sporting equipment, etc.) capped at $1,000 per person; $2,000 per bag and $10,000 aggregate per trip for all covered persons. Secondary to carrier reimbursement. Underwritten by AMEX Assurance Company. New York residents have a different schedule (guide 311-328: $1,250 limits).

travelAccident.notes: No standalone travel accident (common carrier AD&D) insurance is listed among current Platinum benefits. AD&D coverage exists only inside the Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance / Premium Car Rental Protection for the rental period.

roadsideAssistance.notes: Roadside assistance coverage was removed from U.S. Amex consumer cards in January 2020; not offered on the Platinum Card.

travelEmergencyAssistance.notes: Premium Global Assist Hotline: 24/7 emergency medical, legal, financial and other referral/coordination services when traveling more than 100 miles from home; emergency medical transportation/evacuation and repatriation may be provided at no cost only if approved and coordinated by the hotline (third-party provider costs otherwise are the Card Member's responsibility). Trip does not need to be paid with the card.

perks.name: The Centurion Lounge (and Sidecar by The Centurion Lounge)
perks.details: Complimentary access for Basic and Additional Platinum Card Members (Companion Card Members excluded) at 30+ Centurion Lounges. Show the Platinum Card and a same-day confirmed boarding pass with seat/zone assignment on any carrier; entry within 3 hours of departure (same-day round trips are not treated as connections), or within 5 hours of a connecting flight during a layover (5-hour connecting limit effective July 8, 2026). No access after arriving on your final flight. Guests: $50 per adult (18+) and $30 per child aged 2-17 per visit, lap infants under 2 free; since July 8, 2026 guests must be traveling on the SAME FLIGHT as the Card Member. Spend $75,000 in eligible purchases on the card in a calendar year to unlock complimentary access for up to 2 guests per visit for the rest of that year, all of the next year, and through Jan 31 of the year after. Same-flight/5-hour rules apply in the U.S. plus LHR, HND, HKG, SYD and MEL. Sidecar lounges (smaller footprint) follow the same rules.

perks.name: Delta Sky Club access (10 visits per Medallion Year)
perks.details: 10 complimentary Delta Sky Club visits per Medallion Year (Feb 1 - Jan 31) for the Basic Card Member; each eligible Additional Card Member gets their own 10. A 'visit' covers all Sky Club entries and Grab and Go pickups within 24 hours of first entry. Requires a same-day Delta-operated flight or Delta-marketed WestJet (006 ticket); Main Cabin Basic fares excluded; not valid on partner-operated flights or in partner lounges. Spend $75,000 on the card in a calendar year to unlock unlimited visits for the rest of that year, the following year, and through Jan 31 after. Guests: up to 2 guests or spouse/domestic partner and children under 21 at $50 per person per visit ($25 for Grab and Go); children under 2 free. Delta One passengers use Delta One Lounges under Delta's rules. Visit counts reset each Feb 1 and do not carry over.

perks.name: Priority Pass Select membership
perks.details: Enrollment required (enroll in the Amex account; both Basic and Additional Platinum Card Members can enroll). Access to 1,400-1,550+ Priority Pass lounges worldwide with up to 2 complimentary guests; additional guests charged (~$35). The Amex-issued Priority Pass EXCLUDES non-lounge experiences: Priority Pass restaurants/bars (the dining credits), Minute Suites/nap rooms, spas, gaming lounges and similar 'non-lounge' airport experiences are not accessible with the Amex Priority Pass card (since Aug 1, 2019). Use the Priority Pass digital card in the app. Note: the Oct 1, 2026 removal of Priority Pass for Additional Card Members was announced for Amex Australia, not the U.S.; Amex's U.S. Platinum/Additional Platinum guides still say both Basic and Additional Platinum Card Members can enroll.

perks.name: Other Global Lounge Collection partner lounges (Escape, Plaza Premium, Virgin Clubhouse)
perks.details: Escape Lounges (U.S.; 'The Centurion Studio Partner' locations): Card Member plus up to 2 guests free, same-day boarding pass. Plaza Premium Lounges (mostly international): Card Member plus 2 guests free, within 3 hours of departure. Virgin Atlantic Clubhouses at LAX, JFK, SFO, IAD and JNB when flying same-day Virgin Atlantic (or Delta on certain routes) in any cabin. Lufthansa Business/Senator Lounge access ENDED October 1, 2026 (no longer accessible via the Platinum Card even when flying Lufthansa Group). Total network advertised as 1,550+ lounges as of Jan 2026 (count predates the Lufthansa removal).
perks.verificationNotes: Partner-lounge guest rules carried over from the previous refresh; Lufthansa end date confirmed only by secondary sources (OMAAT, Frequent Miler, TPG, MileLion) because americanexpress.com could not be fetched on 2026-10-02.

perks.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status
perks.details: Complimentary Gold Elite status; enrollment required via the Amex account (link your Bonvoy number). Perks: 25% bonus points, enhanced room upgrades when available (not suites), 2 PM late checkout when available, enhanced Wi-Fi. Available at Marriott Bonvoy hotels on qualifying rates. Status stays as long as the card is open.

perks.name: Hilton Honors Gold status
perks.details: Complimentary Gold status; enrollment required via the Amex account. Perks: 80% bonus on base points, space-available room upgrades to preferred rooms, daily food & beverage credit at select U.S. brands (or continental breakfast for two outside the U.S.), 5th night free on standard-room reward stays, two bottles of water at select properties, Milestone Bonuses. Book direct or with accredited agents.

perks.name: Leaders Club Sterling status (The Leading Hotels of the World)
perks.details: New Sept 18, 2025. Complimentary Leaders Club Sterling status at 400+ independent luxury hotels; enrollment required. Perks: 5% Leaders Club points bonus on qualifying stays, 5 pre-arrival upgrade requests per year (subject to availability), daily continental breakfast for two, on-property perks, early check-in/late checkout when available. Leaders Club also became a Membership Rewards transfer partner (4:1) on July 28, 2026.

perks.name: Car rental elite status: Avis Preferred Plus, Hertz Gold Plus Rewards President's Circle, National Emerald Club Executive
perks.details: Enrollment required through the Amex online account (uses card-specific codes, e.g. Avis 756900, Hertz 211762; Hertz status may take 24-72 hours after registration). Avis Preferred Plus: expedited pickup, one-car-class upgrade when available, discounts. Hertz President's Circle (top tier, upgraded from Five Star in 2022): counter bypass, guaranteed one-class upgrade when available, free additional driver, 4-hour grace period. National Emerald Club Executive: choose any car from the Executive Area when booking midsize, free additional driver, one free rental day after 6 rentals. Status renews while the card is open.

perks.name: Fine Hotels + Resorts (FHR) booking benefits
perks.details: 1,800+ luxury properties booked through Amex Travel: daily breakfast for two, room upgrade on arrival when available, $100 credit toward eligible on-property charges (varies by property), guaranteed 4 PM checkout, noon check-in when available, complimentary Wi-Fi; Amex quotes an average value of $550 per two-night stay (2025). Earns 5X on prepaid bookings and counts toward the $600 hotel credit. No minimum stay.

perks.name: The Hotel Collection (THC) booking benefits
perks.details: 1,300+ upscale hotels booked through Amex Travel with a 2-night minimum: $100 credit toward eligible on-property charges, room upgrade on arrival when available, 4 PM late checkout when available, noon check-in when available. Prepaid THC bookings earn 5X and count toward the $600 hotel credit (2-night minimum applies).

perks.name: Platinum Member Airfares (formerly International Airline Program)
perks.details: Launched April 2026, replacing the International Airline Program and Recommended Flights. Discounted fares (Amex cites ~10% / ~$100 average savings) with 30+ participating airlines including Delta, United, British Airways, Emirates, Qatar, Qantas, Singapore, Lufthansa and Turkish; international first, business and premium economy plus select DOMESTIC ECONOMY fares. Bookable only on amextravel.com, the Amex Travel app or via Platinum Travel consultants (no booking fee); up to 8 passengers per itinerary with the Card Member traveling. Earns 5X; can be paid with points.

perks.name: Global Dining Access by Resy and Platinum Nights by Resy
perks.details: Add the Platinum Card to your Resy profile for Global Dining Access: exclusive reservations, Priority Notify, premium dining experiences and 'Platinum Card Member' badge at U.S. Resy restaurants. Platinum Nights by Resy (new Sept 2025): special-access reservations on select nights at in-demand Resy restaurants in select cities (launched with New York, Los Angeles, Miami).

perks.name: Premium Events Collection, Amex Presale/Reserved Tickets and Venue Collection
perks.details: Curated Platinum-only events (sports, fashion, dining, art, performances), Amex Presale and Amex Reserved Tickets, and on-site perks (dedicated entrances/fast lanes) at American Express Venue Collection stadiums and arenas plus 10% back on concessions up to $250/yr (enrollment). The 'Events by Amex'/'Events with Amex' branding was retired June 10, 2026; special ticket access continues under the names above.

perks.name: Platinum Travel Service and Platinum Card concierge
perks.details: Dedicated Platinum Travel Consultants for custom itineraries, FHR/THC bookings and Platinum Member Airfares; 24/7 Card Member Services. No preset spending limit (Pay Over Time may be available).

perks.name: Uber Signature Support for Amex
perks.details: Since May 7, 2026 Platinum Card Members get 'Signature Support for Amex' in the Uber/Uber Eats/Postmates apps: 24/7 live-agent phone support. This replaced Uber VIP status (which had offered top-rated drivers); the $200 Uber Cash and $120 Uber One credits are unchanged.

perks.name: Additional and Companion Platinum Cards
perks.details: Additional Platinum Cards ($195 each per year) receive their own lounge access (Centurion, Delta Sky Club 10 visits, Priority Pass enrollment), hotel/car status enrollment, and insurance coverage, and their charges count toward shared credit caps (airline fee, digital entertainment, Uber One, Oura, etc.), but they do NOT get separate credit pools (exception: each Additional Platinum Card gets its own Global Entry/TSA PreCheck fee credit; Additional Card Members get no Uber Cash). Companion Platinum Cards ($0) earn points and get the Platinum servicing but not lounge access or most benefits.

cards.acceptance: American Express network. Acceptance in the U.S. is near-universal (Amex reports parity with Visa/Mastercard at U.S. merchants that take cards), but Costco warehouses and Costco.com accept only Visa; some small merchants, utilities and landlords add surcharges or refuse Amex. Internationally Amex acceptance is noticeably lower than Visa/Mastercard, especially at small merchants in Europe, Latin America and Southeast Asia; carry a Visa/Mastercard backup abroad. No foreign transaction fees. Card is metal (a limited-edition mirror design was offered at the Sept 2025 refresh) and has No Preset Spending Limit.
recentChanges: 2025-09-18: Major refresh. Annual fee raised from $695 to $895 (new applicants immediately; existing cardholders at first renewal on/after Jan 2, 2026). Additional Platinum Card fee $175 -> $195. New credits: $400 Resy ($100/qtr), $300 lululemon ($75/qtr), $200 Oura Ring (calendar year), $120 Uber One (calendar year). Hotel credit expanded from $200/yr FHR-only to $600/yr ($300 semiannual) and now includes The Hotel Collection (2-night min). Digital Entertainment credit raised from $20 to $25/month ($240 -> $300/yr) and added Paramount+, YouTube Premium and YouTube TV. New perks: Leaders Club Sterling status, Platinum Nights by Resy. Welcome offer up to 175,000 points (varies). No benefits removed at that time.
2026-01-30: Amex announced Centurion Lounge policy tightening effective July 8, 2026 (guests must be on the same flight; connecting passengers limited to 5 hours before departure).
2026-02 (approx.): United TravelBank funding stopped triggering the $200 airline fee credit (data points reported by Upgraded Points); it had been a popular way to cash out the credit.

2026-03-26: Saks Fifth Avenue $50 semiannual credit no longer offered to new Platinum applicants; existing cardholders could use it through June 30, 2026. 2026-07-01: Saks credit retired for all cardholders (Saks Global bankruptcy); Amex said it would introduce 'new and exclusive' Platinum Amex Offers at top retailers starting July 1, 2026.

2026-04 (announced April 10-13, 2026): Platinum Member Airfares launched, replacing the International Airline Program and Recommended Flights, adding select domestic economy discounts across 30+ airlines for up to 8 passengers. Same announcement: Lufthansa Group lounge access (Business/Senator lounges at FRA/MUC) ends October 1, 2026.
2026-05-07: Uber VIP status removed and replaced with 'Signature Support for Amex' (24/7 live-agent support in Uber apps). Uber Cash ($200) and Uber One ($120) credits unchanged.
2026-06-10: 'Events by Amex / Events with Amex' branding discontinued; Premium Events Collection, Amex Presale/Reserved Tickets and Venue Collection continue.
2026-06-30: Etihad Guest removed as a Membership Rewards transfer partner. 2026-07-28: The Leading Hotels of the World Leaders Club added as a transfer partner at 4:1 (20 partners total).
2026-07-01: CLEAR+ credit increased from $209 to $219 per calendar year (matching CLEAR's price increase from $209 to $219).

2026-07-08: Centurion Lounge changes took effect: guests must be traveling on the same flight as the Card Member; connecting passengers admitted only within 5 hours of the connecting flight (3-hour rule for originating departures unchanged). Applies at U.S. lounges plus LHR, HND, HKG, SYD, MEL.

2026-08-01: Digital Entertainment credit terms tightened: Peacock bundled subscriptions (e.g. Peacock + Apple TV), add-on services and subscriptions purchased through third parties are ineligible; standalone Peacock plans bought at peacocktv.com still qualify.

2026-08-01: Resy credit terms changed: a restaurant/venue must be shown as eligible for the Resy Credit (badge on its Resy.com / Resy app page) at the time of purchase; the eligible list can change at any time.
2026-09-15: Select U.S. Tock venues (Tock being merged into Resy) became eligible for the $100/quarter Resy credit when they display the 'Resy Credit eligible' badge.

2026-10-01: Lufthansa Business/Senator lounge access via the Platinum Card ended. Centurion, Delta Sky Club, Priority Pass, Escape, Plaza Premium and Virgin Clubhouse access are unaffected. (The same-day removal of Priority Pass for Additional Card Members applies to Amex Australia, not U.S. cards.)
No new U.S. Platinum changes found announced between Sept 28 and Oct 2, 2026; no 2027 changes announced. The $895 fee and the credit lineup above are current.
gotchas: Most credits require ENROLLMENT in the Amex account before the purchase (Resy, Digital Entertainment, lululemon, Oura, Equinox (at platinum.equinox.com), airline selection, Venue Collection, Priority Pass, hotel/car status). Enrollment can take up to 24 hours; purchases made before enrolling are not credited retroactively.

Credits are use-it-or-lose-it on their own clocks: monthly (Uber Cash expires end of each month at 11:59 PM HST; Digital Entertainment $25; Walmart+), quarterly (Resy $100, lululemon $75), semiannual (hotel $300 Jan-Jun / Jul-Dec), calendar-year (airline $200, CLEAR $219, Uber One $120, Oura $200, Equinox $300). Nothing rolls over. The Q4/second-half windows end Dec 31, so the last week of December is a common miss.

Airline fee credit: you must pick United BEFORE the charges post and can change airlines only in January. Airfare, upgrades, award tickets and gift cards are excluded by terms; United TravelBank loads stopped working around Feb 2026 and award-fee charges around July 2026. Reliable United uses: Economy Plus seats, checked bags, United Club day passes/membership, pet fees, seat selection, in-flight food.

Hotel credit counts only PREPAID Amex Travel FHR/THC bookings ('Pay at hotel' bookings never trigger it), THC needs 2+ nights, and it is based on the CHARGE date, not the stay date. Cancelling a refundable prepaid booking reverses the credit. FHR rates are often higher than direct rates; value comes from the $100 property credit, breakfast and the $300 statement credit.

Digital Entertainment: subscriptions billed through Apple App Store, Google Play, Amazon, Roku or bundled through another carrier do not count; you must be billed directly by Disney/Hulu/ESPN/NYT/WSJ/Paramount+/Peacock/YouTube. Netflix, Max, Apple TV+, Prime Video and Spotify never qualify. Since Aug 1, 2026 Peacock bundles/add-ons are excluded.

Uber One credit requires the membership fee to be charged to the Amex card, so turn Uber Cash OFF for the membership charge; if Uber Cash pays the fee you get no statement credit and burn Uber Cash. Uber Cash is US-only and is Uber Cash, not a statement credit; Additional Card Members do not receive Platinum Uber Cash (official terms).

Oura credit covers the RING only, bought at ouraring.com shipped to a U.S. address; the monthly Oura membership, chargers, warranties, gift cards, and Amazon/Best Buy purchases do not qualify. Splitting payment with PayPal can break it.
lululemon: outlets, non-U.S. stores and third-party retailers are excluded, and online orders post when they SHIP, so late-quarter orders may land in the next quarter. Returns reverse the credit.

Resy credit: no reservation needed, but the U.S. venue must show the 'Resy Credit eligible' badge on Resy at the time of purchase (rule since Aug 1, 2026; list can change). Since Sept 15, 2026 badged Tock venues also count; OpenTable-only restaurants do not. Gift cards and merchandise excluded.
Walmart+ credit only covers the MONTHLY plan ($12.95 + tax); the $98 annual plan is not reimbursed, and Plus Up add-ons are excluded.

Earning is weak outside airfare: 1X on dining, groceries, gas and hotels booked direct. 5X applies only to flights bought from the airline or Amex Travel (not Expedia/Chase Travel) and to PREPAID hotels through Amex Travel (not pay-at-hotel, not direct with the hotel). The 5X flights bonus caps at $500,000 of flight spend per calendar year.

Lounge rules: Centurion entry only within 3 hours of departure (5 hours if connecting), guests $50/$30 unless you spend $75k in a calendar year, and since July 8, 2026 guests must be on your same flight. Delta Sky Club is capped at 10 visits per Medallion Year (Feb-Jan) and requires a same-day Delta flight (Basic Economy excluded); guests are $50 each. Amex's Priority Pass excludes restaurants, Minute Suites and spa credits. Lufthansa lounge access ended Oct 1, 2026. Companion Platinum Card holders have no lounge access.

Insurance requires paying the ENTIRE round-trip fare or rental with the Platinum Card; trip delay needs a 6+ hour delay and is capped at 2 claims/12 months; car rental coverage is SECONDARY (unless you buy Premium Car Rental Protection, ~$19.95-$24.95 per rental for primary coverage) and excludes Australia, Italy and New Zealand; cell phone protection requires last month's wireless bill to have been paid with this card and has a $50 deductible.

Hotel and car statuses (Marriott Gold, Hilton Gold, Leaders Club Sterling, Avis Preferred Plus, Hertz President's Circle, National Executive) are NOT automatic; enroll in the Amex account and allow 24-72 hours.

Membership Rewards points redeemed for statement credits are worth only ~0.6 cpp; flights via Amex Travel are 1.0 cpp; transfers to U.S. airlines (Delta, JetBlue) carry a $0.0006/point fee capped at $99; JetBlue transfers are 1:0.8 and Cathay/Emirates 5:4. Points are forfeited if you close all MR cards without redeeming.
The Saks credit no longer exists (retired July 1, 2026); ignore older guides that count $100 Saks toward the fee offset. Uber VIP status is also gone (replaced by Signature Support).

cards.name: American Express Gold Card
cards.additionalCardFee: Up to 5 Additional Cards at no annual fee; $35 each for the 6th and beyond (americanexpress.com Credit Intel, updated July 17, 2026)

currency.name: Membership Rewards
currency.redemption: Best value: transfer 1:1 (most partners) to 16 airline and 4 hotel programs (as of Aug 2026): Aer Lingus AerClub, Aeromexico Rewards (1:1.6), Air Canada Aeroplan, Air France-KLM Flying Blue, ANA Mileage Club, Avianca LifeMiles, British Airways Club, Cathay Pacific Asia Miles (5:4 since Mar 1, 2026), Delta SkyMiles, Emirates Skywards (5:4 since Sep 2025), Iberia Club, JetBlue TrueBlue (5:4 / 1:0.8, 250-pt min), Qantas Frequent Flyer (500-pt min), Qatar Privilege Club, Singapore KrisFlyer, Virgin Atlantic Flying Club; hotels: Choice Privileges 1:1, Hilton Honors 1:2, Marriott Bonvoy 1:1, Leading Hotels of the World Leaders Club 4:1 (added Jul 2026). Minimum transfer generally 1,000 points. Transfers to US airlines (Delta, JetBlue) carry a federal excise tax offset fee of $0.0006/point, capped at $99 per transaction. Etihad Guest transfers ended June 30, 2026. Fixed-value options: Pay with Points for flights via AmexTravel.com/Amex Travel App at 1.0 cent/point; statement credit ('Cover Your Charges') 0.6 cent/point; prepaid hotels/cars via Amex Travel reported at 0.7-1.0 cent/point (see notes; 0.7 is the long-standing rate, one Aug-2026 source says 1.0); gift cards roughly 0.5-1.0 cent; checkout with points (Amazon, PayPal, etc.) about 0.7 cent. Points do not expire while you hold at least one open Membership Rewards-enrolled card; closing your last MR card forfeits unredeemed points. Transfers to partners are irreversible.

earning.conditions: Restaurants worldwide; cap is $50,000 in purchases per calendar year, then 1X for the rest of the year (cap introduced with the July 2024 refresh).
earning.notes: Official wording: '4X Membership Rewards points per dollar spent on purchases at restaurants worldwide, on up to $50,000 in purchases per calendar year, then 1X points for the rest of the year.' Amex counts takeout and delivery in the U.S. (Grubhub, DoorDash, Uber Eats and similar that code as restaurants). Per Amex's rewards terms as reproduced by secondary sources: merchants not identified as restaurants, or located inside another establishment (hotel, casino, stadium/event venue, department store), and bars/nightclubs, caterers, cafeterias, convenience stores and superstores may not earn 4X; eligibility is by merchant category code. Bonus applies to both Basic and Additional Card purchases against the single account cap.

earning.conditions: U.S. supermarkets only (merchant must be located in the U.S. and coded as a supermarket/grocery store, MCC 5411); $25,000 in purchases per calendar year, then 1X.
earning.notes: Amex definition: stores offering 'a wide variety of food and household products such as meat, fresh produce, dairy, canned and packaged goods, household cleaners, pharmacy products and pet supplies.' Explicit exclusions: superstores (Walmart, Target), warehouse clubs (Costco, Sam's Club, BJ's), convenience stores, specialty stores (fish markets, wine shops, bakeries), meal-kit delivery services, and online superstores (Amazon.com). Examples that qualify per Amex/TPG: Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, ALDI, Kroger, Publix, Safeway, H-E-B, Wegmans, Meijer, Stop & Shop, ShopRite, Winn-Dixie, FreshDirect, Hy-Vee, Vons. Amazon Fresh and Instacart generally code as supermarkets (community reports; not guaranteed). Drugstores (CVS, Walgreens) do not qualify.

earning.conditions: Flights purchased directly from airlines, or booked through AmexTravel.com / the Amex Travel App. No cap.
earning.notes: Official wording: '3X Membership Rewards points on flights booked through AmexTravel.com, the Amex Travel App, or purchased directly from airlines.' Third-party OTAs (Expedia, Priceline, etc.) do not earn 3X. Charter and private-jet flights are excluded per Amex terms as reproduced by One Mile at a Time.

earning.conditions: Prepaid hotel stays booked through AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App and paid at booking. Effective April 30, 2026 (was 2X).
earning.notes: Official wording: '5X Membership Rewards points on prepaid hotel stays booked through AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App.' Pay-at-property (non-prepaid) Amex Travel hotel bookings and hotels booked directly earn 1X. Fine Hotels + Resorts is Platinum-only; Gold gets The Hotel Collection (see credits/perks).

earning.conditions: Prepaid car rentals booked through AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App, and cruises booked and paid through AmexTravel.com.
earning.notes: Official wording: '2X Membership Rewards points on prepaid car rentals booked through AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App and cruises booked and paid through AmexTravel.com.' Car rentals booked directly with the rental company (including Hertz with your Five Star status) earn 1X.

earning.conditions: All other eligible purchases.
earning.notes: Standard Membership Rewards exclusions apply (fees, interest, cash advances, person-to-person payments, balance transfers, purchases of travelers checks/cash equivalents, and Amex gift card purchases are not eligible purchases).

credits.name: Uber Cash
credits.schedule: $10 loaded on the 1st of each calendar month; expires unused at the end of that month (reported as 11:59 PM Hawaii time on the last day); no roll-over; $120 per calendar year.
credits.howToUse: Add the Gold Card as a payment method in your Uber account (no separate Amex enrollment); Uber Cash appears within ~48 hours and then on the 1st of each month. Valid only for rides and Uber Eats/Postmates orders in the U.S.; at checkout you must select an American Express card as the payment method and have Uber Cash toggled on. Only the Basic (primary) Card Member gets the benefit (Additional Cards do not). If the same card is added to multiple Uber accounts, only the first account gets it. Does not auto-apply on business profiles. Uber Cash can pay for tips inside the app; it cannot be used for Uber gift cards.

credits.name: $120 Dining Credit
credits.schedule: Up to $10 in statement credits per calendar month (resets on the 1st); unused amounts do not roll over; up to $120 per calendar year.
credits.howToUse: Enroll once in the Benefits section of your Amex account (or by phone); enrollment can take up to 24 hours. Pay with the enrolled Gold Card (Basic or Additional Cards on the account count toward the one $10 monthly limit) at the listed merchants; the credit posts automatically, usually within days but allow up to 8 weeks. Grubhub pickup and delivery both qualify (Grubhub gift cards do not). Gift-card purchases at any of the five merchants are excluded. Goldbelly and Wine.com were removed effective July 1, 2026; Buffalo Wild Wings and Wonder were added April 30, 2026. Merchant list is subject to change.

credits.name: $100 Resy Credit
credits.schedule: Up to $50 in statement credits January-June and up to $50 July-December ($100 per calendar year); unused amounts do not carry over between halves.
credits.howToUse: Enroll in the Benefits section of your Amex account (Basic Card Member or Authorized Account Manager). Then pay the restaurant bill with the enrolled Gold Card at a U.S. restaurant/food-and-beverage venue that accepts Amex AND is marked as eligible for the Resy Credit on its Resy.com / Resy app page at the time of purchase (since August 1, 2026 Amex requires this 'credit-eligible' badge; Amex told media no restaurants were removed when the badge launched and that more venues, e.g. Tock restaurants moving to Resy, will be added). Since Sept 15, 2026 select U.S. Tock venues that display the 'Resy Credit eligible' badge also qualify (Gold, Platinum and Delta Reserve); international Tock venues do not. A Resy reservation is NOT required (walk-ins and takeout count). Purchases made directly on Resy.com/the Resy app also count. Excluded per Amex terms: restaurants located inside another business (e.g., hotel or department store), non-dining purchases (Resy merchandise, Resy OS software, Resy-branded Amex gift cards, gift cards bought at restaurants), and transactions processed through a third-party system (mobile card readers or payment platforms). Resy Pay: older terms (as quoted May 2026) excluded it, while current Amex benefit text surfaced in search lists 'purchases made via Resy Pay' as eligible -- treat as uncertain. Paying with the physical/virtual card directly at the restaurant is safest. Credits usually post within days (allow up to 8 weeks). Both Basic and Additional Cards count toward the account limit.
credits.uncertainNote: Resy Pay eligibility conflicts between sources (older terms excluded it; current Amex benefit text reportedly includes it).

credits.name: $84 Dunkin' Credit
credits.schedule: Up to $7 in statement credits per calendar month; resets on the 1st; no roll-over; up to $84 per calendar year across all Cards on the account.
credits.categoryTagsNote: coffee shop / quick-service; Amex codes Dunkin' as a restaurant
credits.howToUse: Enroll in the Benefits section of your Amex account (up to 24 hours to take effect). Pay with the enrolled Gold Card at U.S. Dunkin' locations that accept Amex (9,000+ per Amex), in store, drive-thru, or via the Dunkin' app (in-app card reloads paid with the Gold Card are widely reported to trigger the credit but this is not stated in Amex's terms). Multiple small transactions can be combined to reach $7. Excluded: Dunkin' gift cards purchased online, Dunkin'-branded products bought at other retailers (grocery stores etc.), orders through third-party delivery apps, and Dunkin' kiosks inside other establishments (e.g., gas stations) that don't code as Dunkin'. Credits usually post within days; allow up to 8 weeks.

credits.name: The Hotel Collection $100 credit
credits.periodNote: Per qualifying stay (not an annual allowance); available on each eligible booking.
credits.schedule: Awarded per eligible stay of two or more consecutive nights at a Hotel Collection property booked through AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App.
credits.howToUse: Book a NEW stay of 2+ consecutive nights at a participating Hotel Collection property on AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App and pay with the Gold Card. You get a $100 credit toward qualifying on-property charges (typically dining, spa, golf or other hotel facilities; eligible charges vary by property) -- it cannot be used for the room rate, taxes, fees or gratuities -- plus a room upgrade on arrival when available (some room categories excluded). Limit one credit per room per stay, up to three rooms per eligible Card Member per stay. The credit must be used during that stay, cannot be carried over, has no cash value and expires at check-out. Booking directly with the hotel or via other OTAs does not qualify. Not a monthly/annual statement credit.
credits.verificationNote: All terms (2-night minimum, qualifying charges, exclusions, 1 credit per room per stay / 3-room limit, expires at check-out, upgrade when available, valid for U.S. Consumer Gold) are from Amex Travel's official Hotel Collection pages. Amex's card page says 1,300+ hotels; the Amex Travel page says 1,400+.

credits.name: Uber One annual membership credit (limited-time, 60th anniversary)
credits.schedule: One-time statement credit of up to $96 for an ANNUAL Uber One membership purchased with the Gold Card by October 30, 2026; enrollment through Amex Offers required first.
credits.howToUse: In your Amex account, find and add the Uber One offer under Amex Offers, then make a single purchase of an ANNUAL (not monthly) Uber One membership at uber.com or in the Uber, Uber Eats or Postmates app, paying with the Gold Card; turn your Uber Cash balance OFF for that purchase so the full fee charges to the card. Credit posts within up to 8 weeks. Membership auto-renews at full price the following year. Offer valid through 10/30/2026; Upgraded Points and Kudos report you must have been a Gold Card Member by 10/16/2026 to enroll (offer terms not viewable without login).

rentalCar.limit: Up to $50,000 per Rental Agreement for damage to or theft of the rental vehicle (plus reasonable loss-of-use, towing, storage and appraisal charges)
rentalCar.duration: First 30 consecutive days per rental from the same rental company (extensions/new agreements do not restart the clock)
rentalCar.notes: Must reserve and pay the entire rental with the Gold Card (Membership Rewards / Pay with Points OK) and decline the rental company's full CDW/LDW. Not available for vehicles rented in Australia, Italy or New Zealand, or OFAC-sanctioned countries. Excluded vehicles include cargo/custom vans, vans seating more than 8, box trucks and trucks with GVWR of 10,000 lbs or more, modified vehicles, vehicles used for commercial/hire purposes, leased vehicles, antique cars (20+ years old), limousines, off-road vehicles, motorcycles, mopeds and RVs (plus exotic/high-value vehicles per the full guide). No liability, uninsured-motorist or personal-injury coverage. Underwritten by AMEX Assurance Company; Benefit Guide Rev. 4/19/2024 (file dated 04/02/2026). Optional paid Premium Car Rental Protection (primary) can be enrolled separately.

purchaseProtection.notes: Covers accidental damage, theft or loss of a Covered Purchase for up to 90 days from purchase; up to $10,000 per Covered Purchase and $50,000 per Eligible Card per calendar year; natural-disaster events capped at $500 per event. Secondary to homeowner's/renter's insurance and retailer/manufacturer contracts. Only the amount charged to the card qualifies. Exclusions include items left unsafeguarded (e.g., unlocked vehicle), property in a third party's care (including common carriers), and standard consumable/perishable/motorized-vehicle-type exclusions. Benefit Guide 316-404 Rev. 4/19/2024.

extendedWarranty.notes: Adds up to one additional year to original manufacturer's warranties of five years or less (U.S.-valid warranties); coverage begins after the manufacturer's warranty and any purchased service contract expire, but the combined original warranty + service contract may not exceed 5 years. Up to $10,000 per Covered Purchase and $50,000 per Eligible Card per calendar year; only the amount charged to the card qualifies. Benefit Guide 314-399 Rev. 4/19/2024.

returnProtection.notes: The consumer American Express Gold Card is not on Amex's Return Protection eligible-card list (only the legacy 'Senior Gold Card' appears).

cellPhone.conditions: Not offered on the consumer Gold Card; Amex's Cell Phone Protection eligible-card list includes Platinum, Business Gold, Delta Platinum/Reserve, Bonvoy Brilliant, Hilton Aspire and Centurion, but not the Gold Card.

tripDelay.notes: Reimburses reasonable additional expenses (meals, lodging, toiletries, medication, personal items) when a Covered Trip is delayed MORE than 12 hours; up to $300 per Covered Trip and 2 claims per Eligible Card per 12 consecutive months. The full round-trip common-carrier fare must be charged to the Gold Card (points/Pay with Points OK). Covered causes are limited to: inclement weather, terrorist action or hijacking, common-carrier equipment failure, and lost/stolen passports or travel documents -- crew scheduling, air-traffic control and most other operational delays are NOT covered. Secondary to any airline compensation. Notify the administrator within 60 days (1-844-933-0648). Underwritten by New Hampshire Insurance Company (AIG).

tripCancellation.notes: No Trip Cancellation/Interruption Insurance on the Gold Card (Platinum-tier and Delta Reserve/Platinum cards only).

baggageDelay.notes: Amex's Baggage Insurance Plan covers lost/damaged/stolen baggage only; there is no baggage-delay reimbursement on any Amex card.

lostLuggage.notes: Baggage Insurance Plan: up to $1,250 per Covered Person for carry-on baggage and up to $500 per Covered Person for checked baggage (lost, damaged or stolen while checked with or carried on a common carrier, or in direct transit to/from the terminal). High-risk items (jewelry, electronics, computers, cameras, sporting equipment, furs, precious-metal items, wearables) capped at $250 total per person per trip. New York residents: $10,000 aggregate per trip. The entire common-carrier fare must be charged to the Gold Card; coverage is secondary to the carrier's reimbursement. Underwritten by AMEX Assurance Company; Benefit Guide 311-328 Rev. 4/19/2024.

travelAccident.notes: Not listed on the official Gold Card page and not attributed to the Gold Card in TPG's Dec-2025 Amex travel-protections guide (Amex removed Travel Accident Insurance from most cards in 2020). One Upgraded Points page (Jan 2026) still lists $100,000 common-carrier AD&D for Gold; Amex's Travel Accident policy page could not be loaded to confirm. Treat as NOT provided.

roadsideAssistance.notes: Premium Roadside Assistance is not offered on the Gold Card (removed in 2020; not listed on the official card page).

travelEmergencyAssistance.notes: Global Assist Hotline: 24/7 medical, legal, financial and other emergency coordination/referral services when traveling more than 100 miles from home. Referrals are free; third-party costs (e.g., medical care, transport) are generally the Card Member's responsibility.

perks.name: Hertz Five Star status (added April 30, 2026)
perks.details: Complimentary Hertz Gold Plus Rewards Five Star status for Basic and Additional Card Members. Enrollment required in the Benefits section of your Amex account (or by phone); you must already have a Hertz Gold Plus Rewards number registered with the SAME email as your Amex account; status appears within ~72 hours and is retained while you remain an eligible Card Member. Benefits: one-class vehicle upgrade when available, skip-the-counter/expedited pickup at select locations, free additional driver (spouse/domestic partner), 25% bonus Hertz points, wider Ultimate Choice selection.

perks.name: The Hotel Collection access
perks.details: Book 2+ consecutive nights at participating Hotel Collection properties (1,300+ per the card page; 1,400+ per Amex Travel) through AmexTravel.com or the Amex Travel App for a $100 on-property credit (dining/spa/golf-type charges; not room, taxes or fees) and a room upgrade on arrival when available; these bookings also earn 5X when prepaid. Limited-time 60th-anniversary offers (free 3rd/4th nights, discounts, extra credits) ran through July 15, 2026.

perks.name: Welcome offer (varies)
perks.details: Publicly 'as high as 100,000 Membership Rewards points after $8,000 in eligible purchases in the first 6 months' (spend requirement raised from $6,000 on April 30, 2026); many applicants are shown 60,000-90,000. Amex 'once per lifetime' rule per product and family restrictions apply; the application flow tells you before a hard pull whether you are eligible.

perks.name: Amex Offers (including Gold-curated 60th-anniversary offers)
perks.details: Targeted merchant statement-credit/bonus-point offers you add in your account; since April 30, 2026 Gold members also see a curated set (e.g., CLEAR+, Williams Sonoma, HBO Max, Uber One) -- limited-time and vary by account.

perks.name: Pay with Points / Amex Travel
perks.details: Redeem points at 1.0 cent each for flights on AmexTravel.com/Amex Travel App; the new Amex Travel App (launched late 2025) consolidates booking, benefit enrollment and credit usage trackers.

perks.name: No foreign transaction fees
perks.details: 0% FX fee on purchases abroad; note Amex acceptance is thinner than Visa/Mastercard outside the U.S.

perks.name: Additional Cards
perks.details: Up to 5 Additional Cards free; $35/yr each beyond 5. Additional Card spend earns points into the same account and counts toward the account's 4X caps and monthly credit limits (Dining, Dunkin', Resy) but Additional Card Members do not get their own Uber Cash.

perks.name: Send & Split, Plan It, Pay Over Time
perks.details: Standard Amex account features (split charges via Venmo/PayPal, fixed-fee installment plans, revolve eligible charges). Not verified on the Gold product page during this research; listed for completeness.

cards.acceptance: American Express network. Widely accepted in the U.S. but still refused by a minority of small merchants; Costco U.S. warehouses, Costco gas stations and Costco.com accept Visa only. Acceptance abroad is materially lower than Visa/Mastercard, especially at small restaurants and shops in Europe, Latin America and parts of Asia -- carry a Visa/Mastercard backup. No foreign transaction fee. Metal card.
