tripCancellation.notes: No trip cancellation/interruption insurance on this card.

baggageDelay.notes: Up to $100 per day for up to 3 days for essential items (toiletries, change of clothes, one charger per device) when checked baggage is delayed more than 6 hours by a Common Carrier; pay all or part of the fare with the card and/or points; covers you and Family Members even if not traveling with you; secondary to other reimbursement. Common Carrier = scheduled planes, trains, ferries, cruise ships; NOT taxis, car service, rental cars, rideshare, commuter rail or commuter bus. Report within 20 days.

lostLuggage.notes: $3,000 per Covered Traveler per trip for checked or carry-on baggage lost, damaged or stolen by the Common Carrier (actual cash value less carrier reimbursement); sub-limits $500 jewelry/watches and $500 cameras/electronics. New York residents: additionally limited to $2,000 per bag and $10,000 for all covered travelers per trip. Secondary. Report within 20 days.

travelAccident.notes: Accidental death/dismemberment: up to $500,000 Common Carrier Travel Accident and $100,000 Twenty-Four Hour Travel Accident per Covered Traveler when all or part of the common carrier fare (air, bus, train, cruise) is paid with the card and/or points; aggregate 2x per accident; excludes commuting to/from work, pilots/crew, illness, racing, etc.

roadsideAssistance.notes: Pay-per-use Roadside Dispatch (not free): call 1-800-349-2634, 24/7 in the US and Canada, no enrollment. A pre-negotiated per-service fee (quoted on the call) is billed to the card and covers standard towing up to 5 miles, tire change, jump start (EVs towed to nearest charger), lockout (no key replacement), up to 5 gallons fuel delivery (fuel cost extra), standard winching within 100 feet of a paved road. Light-duty vehicles (10,000 lb or less) only.

travelEmergencyAssistance.notes: Referral and coordination only (medical/legal referrals, emergency transportation arrangements, ticket replacement, lost luggage locator, translation, prescription assistance, pre-trip info) 24/7 at 1-800-349-2634 or collect 001-214-503-2951; you pay for any actual services. Covers you, spouse/domestic partner and dependent children under 26.

perks.name: Prime Card Bonus (10%+ back on rotating Amazon items)
perks.details: Eligible Prime cardmembers earn 10% back or more TOTAL (5% base + extra) on a rotating selection of items and categories shipped and sold by Amazon.com; limited-time, while supplies last, automatic with no sign-up; excludes Installments, Prime Wardrobe and Amazon Fresh; extra % posts within about a week. Deals page: amazon.com/b?node=121188110011 (tiers of 10%, 15%, 20% total shown Sept 2026).

perks.name: Extra rewards for slower delivery options
perks.details: Promotional, appears at checkout when available: extra 1% (6% total) for Amazon Day or No-Rush Delivery; extra 2-3% (7-8% total) during Prime Day, Prime Big Deal Days and holidays. Items shipped by Amazon only; not on software subscriptions, gift cards, digital video games or memberships; voided if you cancel or change shipping speed. Requires eligible Prime.

perks.name: Daily Rewards / Shop with Points
perks.details: Points post Sunday-Friday and are usable at Amazon.com checkout as soon as the next day, no minimum; automatic Shop with Points enrollment when the card is in your Amazon wallet; also usable in-store at Whole Foods via the app In-Store Code.

perks.name: Equal monthly payments (0% promo APR) at Amazon.com and Amazon Pay retailers
perks.details: 0% promo APR for 6 months on purchases of $50+ or 12 months on $250+; you must choose it at checkout and those purchases earn NO % back. Standard variable APR 18.74%-27.49% applies afterward (Sept 2026).

perks.name: Chase Offers
perks.details: Merchant-funded statement-credit offers added in the Chase app; credits post in 7-14 business days.

perks.name: Free authorized users
perks.details: No fee; their purchases earn rewards to your account.

perks.name: New cardmember Amazon Gift Card
perks.details: Currently $150 loaded instantly on approval (Sept 2026; was $200 June 11-July 9, 2026 and $250 in Nov 2025). Only for applicants who do not currently have an Amazon Visa or Prime Visa; cannot be used to buy other gift cards.

perks.name: Visa Signature network perks (concierge, Luxury Hotel Collection)
perks.details: Widely reported by secondary sources (Bankrate, Upgraded Points) for Visa Signature-designated Prime Visa accounts; NOT listed on Chase's or Amazon's benefit pages or in the Chase Guide to Benefits, and some accounts are issued as Visa Platinum (the Guide covers 'Visa Signature and Visa Platinum'). Treat as unverified.

perks.name: Zero Liability, contactless, digital wallets
perks.details: Zero liability for unauthorized charges (not for an authorized user's use without the primary's approval); tap to pay; Apple Pay/Google Pay/Samsung Pay.

cards.acceptance: Visa credit card: accepted anywhere Visa is accepted, including Costco warehouses and Costco gas stations, which accept 'All Visa Cards' in-store (Costco payment-methods page published 03/02/2026; Costco.com also takes Mastercard). No foreign transaction fees, so usable abroad; 5% is not earned on international Amazon sites or international Whole Foods. Rewards points can only be spent via Shop with Points at Amazon.com/Whole Foods in-store/Amazon Pay merchants or redeemed at chase.com; they are not Ultimate Rewards.
recentChanges: 2025-11 (Wayback 2025-11-14): Holiday welcome offer of $250 Amazon Gift Card on approval; back to $150 by Feb 2026.

2026-01-09: Rewards Program Agreement revised (RPA0441_0510, printed date 01/09/2026): codifies 5-2-1 vs 3-2-1 structure, Chase Travel definition (excludes FROSCH), Daily Rewards, Amazon Pay exclusion, and the rule that the card drops to 3% if the Amazon account loses eligible Prime, unlinks the card, is closed, selects a different card, or opens another Prime Visa.
2026-06-11 to 2026-07-09: Welcome offer raised to $200 Amazon Gift Card for Prime Day (Doctor of Credit, The Points Guy); reverted to $150 afterward.

2026-06/07 (between Wayback snapshots 2026-06-08 and 2026-07-12): Chase and Amazon changed the 5% headline from 'Amazon.com, Amazon Fresh, Whole Foods Market, and on Chase Travel' to 'Amazon.com, Audible.com, Whole Foods Market, and on Chase Travel'. Amazon Fresh STILL earns 5% (fine print: 'Amazon Fresh orders'; Amazon benefits page: 'and on Amazon Fresh'). amazon.com/primevisa/benefits now explicitly lists Audible.com, Shopbop, Twitch/Woot via Amazon Pay, Prime Video, Kindle Unlimited, Amazon Pharmacy, One Medical, PillPack as earning 5%, and explicitly EXCLUDES Zappos, Ring, AbeBooks, Blink, Eero, Amazon Games, Wondery, Amazon Music and Buy with Prime. Whether Audible newly began earning 5% or was merely newly advertised could not be verified.

2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30: Targeted (not universal) promotion reported by Kudos: 5%-9% TOTAL back at grocery stores, gas stations and restaurants on up to $1,000 combined spend, excluding Amazon.com/Whole Foods; bonus posts 6-8 weeks after the promo ends. Not verifiable from public official pages (verified: false). Promotion window ENDED 2026-09-30; no Q4 2026 (Oct-Dec) targeted category offer found as of 2026-10-02 (prior years ran Oct 1-Dec 31 offers via chase.com/mybonus, so check your Chase account).

2026-09 (current): $0 annual fee, no FX fee, $150 gift card offer, variable APR 18.74%-27.49% (penalty up to 29.99%), cash advance APR 28.49%, balance transfer/cash advance fee greater of $5 or 4% (Chase Pricing & Terms LGC59329). No devaluation of the 5/2/1 structure found.

2026-10-02: Quarterly re-check: no changes to the 5%/2%/1% structure, $0 annual fee, no FX fee, $150 welcome gift card, APR range, or Guide to Benefits BGC11359 protections found since 2026-09-28. Prime Visa remains EXCLUDED from Chase's co-brand DoorDash DashPass benefit (12 months free DashPass for activations through 12/31/2027, plus $10/month non-restaurant discount for first-time activations 09/01/2026-12/31/2027 on eligible co-brands; Amazon, Instacart and DoorDash cards excluded) and is not part of the Chase-Lyft earning partnership (Sapphire/Freedom/Ink only, through 2027-09-30).
gotchas: Prime lapse: if your Amazon account loses an eligible Prime membership (or the Prime Video-only plan / invited-guest status is all you have), the card keeps working but Amazon/Whole Foods/Chase Travel earning drops from 5% to 3%, and Prime Card Bonus and delivery-option bonuses stop. Earning status is set at time of purchase; check Your Account > Your Payments > expand the card.

Only ONE card per Amazon account earns 5%. If you have multiple Amazon accounts, multiple Amazon/Prime Visas, or switched accounts, you may silently earn 3% until you confirm and select the card under Manage Payment Options.
Choosing equal monthly payments / promotional financing (0% APR) at Amazon checkout or via Amazon Pay forfeits ALL rewards on that purchase.
Amazon Pay at third-party merchants does NOT earn 5% (only 1%, or 2% if the merchant codes as gas/restaurant/transit); exceptions are Twitch and Woot.

Not all Amazon brands count: Zappos, Ring.com, Blink, Eero, AbeBooks, Amazon Games, Wondery, Amazon Music and Buy with Prime checkouts are excluded from 5%; international Amazon sites are excluded. Amazon.com gift cards DO earn 5%.
Whole Foods through Instacart, Shipt or other third parties, online Whole Foods gift cards, in-store third-party vendors and massage services do not earn 5%.
Prime Card Bonus percentages are TOTAL (include the base 5%); they exclude Amazon Fresh, Prime Wardrobe and Installments and require items shipped and sold by Amazon.com.
Portions of a purchase paid with points or gift-card balance earn nothing; returns claw back points and can push the balance negative.

Category earning is merchant-code based: restaurants inside grocery/department stores, hotels, stadiums and theme parks; bakeries; caterers; meal kits; truck stops; EV chargers; bike/scooter rentals; car sharing; airlines and car rentals do not earn 2%. Third-party payment apps or wallets that mask the merchant category can drop you to 1%.
Chase Travel earns 5% only for prepaid bookings on chasetravel.com or by phone; the same airfare or hotel booked directly earns 1%; FROSCH bookings excluded.
Rewards are not Ultimate Rewards: no transfer partners, no pooling with other Chase cards, fixed 1 cent per point on every option.

Auto rental coverage is SECONDARY in the US (primary abroad); you must decline the rental company's CDW/LDW, pay the full rental with the card, and peer-to-peer rentals (Turo) and vehicles over $125,000 MSRP are excluded; 31-day limit.

No trip cancellation/interruption, no trip delay, no cell phone protection, no return protection. Baggage/travel accident benefits define Common Carrier to exclude rideshare, taxis, commuter rail and commuter bus.
Roadside Assistance is pay-per-use dispatch (a fee is charged to the card), not free towing.
New York residents: Purchase Protection window is 90 days; Lost Luggage additionally capped at $2,000 per bag and $10,000 per trip.

Welcome gift card only for applicants without an existing Amazon Visa or Prime Visa; the card is issued as Visa Signature or Visa Platinum depending on credit line, so Visa Signature-only network perks are not guaranteed.

No Chase partner perks: unlike most Chase cards, the Prime Visa gets NO complimentary DoorDash DashPass or DoorDash monthly discount (Chase co-brand DashPass terms exclude the Amazon cards) and NO bonus earning on Lyft (Lyft rides earn the normal 2% local transit/rideshare rate).

cards.name: Marriott Bonvoy Boundless Credit Card

currency.name: Marriott Bonvoy points
currency.redemption: Points post to your Marriott Bonvoy account after each statement cycle (Chase RPA). Primary use: award nights at 30+ Marriott Bonvoy brands using dynamic 'Flexible Point Redemption Rates' (no published award chart since March 29, 2022; since 2023 nightly rates float with cash rates, from ~5,000 points at the cheapest properties to 120,000+ at flagship resorts). Fifth night free on award stays of 5+ consecutive nights (widely reported Bonvoy rule; not re-verified on an official page in this research). Cash + Points, PointSavers, Marriott Bonvoy Moments experiences, gift cards/merchandise, car rentals and cruises via partners. Airline transfers: 3 Bonvoy points = 1 mile to ~38 airline partners, 3,000-240,000 points per day, with 5,000 bonus miles per 60,000 points transferred in one request (United gets 10,000 bonus per 60,000; American AAdvantage, Delta SkyMiles and Avianca LifeMiles get no bonus; Air New Zealand is 200:1). Point transfers to other members: up to 100,000 points per year. Expiration: entire balance forfeits after 24 consecutive months with no qualifying earning or redemption activity; any card purchase resets the clock (transfers/gifts do not). Third-party valuations Sept 2026: TPG 0.75 cents, Frequent Miler 0.73 cents (7/23/26), OMAAT 0.7 cents per point; average award-price increase of roughly 5-10% in early July 2026 pushed values down.

earning.conditions: Pay at the hotel or on marriott.com/app. The 6x is card-earned; the ~10x base + elite bonus Bonvoy points come with any payment method, so only the 6x counts when comparing cards.
earning.notes: The 6 points per $1 are the card-earned points only; the RPA states 'You will only receive the accelerated earn of 6 points for each $1 spent from this credit card program' and that additional Bonvoy member points are earned under Bonvoy program terms. Bonvoy base earning per Sept 2026 program terms: 10 points per US$ of eligible charges at most brands; 5 points per US$ at Residence Inn, TownePlace Suites, Element, Protea, Homes & Villas, Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy, City Express and Four Points Flex; 4 at StudioRes; plus the elite bonus (Silver 10%, Gold 25%). Marriott's marketing 'up to 17X' = 6 card + up to 10 base + up to 1 Silver bonus. Card points accrue on the whole charge including taxes and resort fees; Bonvoy base points accrue only on eligible folio charges. Bookings through third-party sites (Expedia etc.) generally do not earn Bonvoy base points or Elite Night Credits and may not code as a Marriott merchant. Marriott is responsible for reporting participating hotels to Chase for 6X coding.

earning.conditions: Cap is $6,000 COMBINED across gas stations, grocery stores and dining. 'Annually' per the RPA = account-open date through the first December statement cycle date, then each December-statement-to-December-statement year (approximately calendar year, tied to your December statement date).
earning.notes: Chase gas station category: 'Merchants in this category sell automotive gasoline that can be paid for either at the pump or inside the station and may or may not sell other goods.' Not included: truck stops, boat marinas, oil and propane distributors, home heating companies. EV charging is not named as included; only counts if the merchant codes as a gas station. Warehouse-club fuel (Costco, Sam's) codes under the warehouse club merchant code, not gas, and is not guaranteed to earn 3X. Pay-inside and pay-at-pump both qualify.

earning.conditions: Shares the $6,000 combined annual cap with gas and dining.
earning.notes: Chase grocery stores category: 'supermarkets, merchants that offer a full-service grocery line of merchandise including a deli and bakery as well as smaller grocery stores.' Excluded: larger stores that sell a wide variety of goods and groceries such as Walmart and Target, wholesale/warehouse clubs (Costco, Sam's, BJ's), discount stores, drugstores, merchants specializing in only a few grocery items, and gas stations operated by grocery merchants. Delivery services count only if the merchant itself is classified as a grocery store (e.g., a supermarket's own delivery; Instacart commonly codes as grocery but is not guaranteed).

earning.conditions: Shares the $6,000 combined annual cap with gas and groceries. RPA wording: 'dining at restaurants including takeout and eligible delivery services'.
earning.notes: Chase dining category: sit-down or eat-in dining including fast food and fine dining; takeout if the merchant classifies as a restaurant; eligible delivery services named by Chase: DoorDash, Caviar, Uber Eats, Postmates, Grubhub, Seamless and Delivery.com. Excluded: restaurants located inside sports stadiums, hotels and casinos, theme parks, grocery and department stores; bakeries, caterers, meal-kit services and other third-party delivery. A restaurant charge inside a Marriott hotel that is billed to the room folio earns 6X as a Marriott purchase instead.

All other purchases, no cap. Excluded from 'purchases' per RPA: balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions (travelers checks, foreign currency, money orders, wire transfers, cryptocurrency, lottery/casino/wagering, person-to-person transfers, account funding), checks that access the account, interest, unauthorized charges, and fees including the annual fee. Marriott's own site also markets 2X on 'other travel purchases', which is simply the base rate.

credits.name: Airline statement credit ($50 per half-year after $250 with an airline; limited-time)
credits.schedule: Two $50 credits, each after $250+ spent directly with airlines in a half-year window, max $100 total. EXISTING cardmembers (approved before 1/7/2026): Jan 1-Jun 30, 2026 and Jul 1-Dec 31, 2026; offer ends 12/31/2026. NEW cardmembers approved 6/4/2026-12/31/2026: Jun 4-Dec 31, 2026 and Jan 1-Jun 30, 2027; offer ends 6/30/2027. Credits post within 6-8 weeks of meeting the threshold.
credits.howToUse: Existing cardmembers must complete a one-time activation via the Chase offer link/email (reported as chase.com/mybonus/marriott-airline-credit) or by phone (new applicants are auto-registered at card activation). Pay the airline directly (airline website, app, counter): tickets, award taxes/fees, bag fees and paid upgrades were reported by cardholders to count; United TravelBank loads reported to work. Purchases through travel agencies/online travel sites and Chase Travel do not qualify. Only $50 per half-year window regardless of spend above $250. Chase may reverse the credit if the account is closed within 90 days of receiving it. This is a promotional benefit, not a permanent card feature. Some secondary write-ups (Oct 2026) describe the credit as running through 6/30/2027 for all cardholders; per the offer terms seen so far that end date applies to the new-cardmember cohort, while existing cardmembers' offer ends 12/31/2026 - check your own offer terms.

credits.name: DoorDash $10 off one non-restaurant order per quarter
credits.schedule: One $10 discount per calendar quarter, applied at DoorDash checkout (not a statement credit), through 12/31/2027; requires an active DashPass membership tied to the card.
credits.howToUse: Add the Boundless card as the default payment method in DoorDash, activate the Chase DashPass benefit (by 12/31/2027), then place one qualifying non-restaurant order (grocery, convenience, retail, pet, etc.) per quarter using the enrolled card; the $10 applies to subtotal only (not fees, taxes, tip). Any unused portion of the $10 on that order is forfeited; one redemption per quarter per person. Lost if DashPass lapses.

rentalCar.limit: Official Chase benefits page: 'reimbursement for theft and collision damage for most rental vehicles.' Dollar cap not stated on official page; secondary source (hellosafe, checked against Guide BGC10784) cites up to $60,000 (unverified).
rentalCar.duration: 31 consecutive days per rental (secondary source; Guide to Benefits not directly retrieved)
rentalCar.notes: Secondary to personal auto insurance in the U.S.; secondary sources state it becomes primary outside the U.S. or when the cardholder has no personal auto policy. Must reserve and pay the entire rental with the card and decline the rental company's CDW/LDW. Typical exclusions reported: exotic/antique cars, motorcycles, trucks, expensive luxury vehicles, peer-to-peer rentals (Turo). Covers damage, theft, reasonable towing and loss-of-use; not liability or personal effects.

purchaseProtection.notes: Official page: 'Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $500 per item' (90 days for New York residents). The $50,000 per-account maximum comes from secondary sources citing the Guide to Benefits, not the official page (unverified).

extendedWarranty.notes: Official page: 'Extends the time period of the manufacturer's U.S. warranty by an additional year, on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from the date of purchase.' Secondary sources cite $10,000 per claim / $50,000 per account (unverified).

tripDelay.notes: Official page: common carrier travel delayed more than 12 hours or requiring an overnight stay; covers unreimbursed expenses such as meals and lodging up to $500 per covered traveler/ticket. Fare must be paid with the card.

tripCancellation.notes: Trip cancellation/interruption insurance is NOT listed on the official Boundless benefits page; secondary sources confirm it is absent (the Amex Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant has it; Boundless does not).

baggageDelay.notes: Official page: 'up to $100 a day for up to 5 days' for essential purchases when checked baggage is delayed more than 6 hours by the carrier. (One secondary source says 3 days; the official page's 5 days governs.)

lostLuggage.notes: Official page: up to $3,000 per covered traveler for checked or carry-on luggage lost or damaged by the carrier (New York residents: $2,000 per bag, $10,000 total per trip). Secondary to carrier reimbursement; jewelry/watches/electronics sub-limits apply per secondary sources.

travelAccident.notes: Official page: 'When you pay for your air, bus, train, or cruise transportation with your Card, you are eligible to receive up to $500,000 in accidental death or dismemberment coverage.'

roadsideAssistance.notes: Roadside Dispatch (pay-per-use, not free): official page says 'call the service provider to dispatch the help you need. Roadside service fees will be billed to your Card at the time of dispatch.' Secondary source cites $69.95 per service call (unverified). US and Canada, 24/7.

travelEmergencyAssistance.notes: Official page: 'Provides legal and medical referrals and access to other travel and emergency assistance services'; the cardholder pays for any services actually rendered. Referral/coordination only; no medical or evacuation coverage.

perks.name: Annual Free Night Award (up to 35,000 points, top-up to 60,000)
perks.details: One Free Night Award deposited to your Bonvoy account each year after your account anniversary (allow up to 8 weeks). Valid for one night in a standard room at a participating hotel with a redemption level up to 35,000 points, inclusive of room rate and taxes; since March 12, 2026 you can add up to 25,000 of your own points (previously 15,000) to book a night priced up to 60,000 points. Expires 12 months from deposit; Chase FAQ: 'expiration dates cannot be extended'; cannot be transferred, combined with cash, or re-credited for points. Mandatory resort/destination fees and incidentals are the guest's responsibility. Book online/in-app while logged in; participating-property list applies (some brands such as Homes & Villas do not accept awards). Approximate value at TPG's 0.75 cent valuation: about $260 before top-up; after the July 2026 award-price increases many hotels formerly at or under 35,000 now price just above it and require a top-up.

perks.name: Automatic Silver Elite status
perks.details: Granted each calendar year as a cardmember (allow up to 8 weeks from account opening). Silver benefits per marriott.com: 10% bonus points on eligible stay charges, Priority Late Checkout (subject to availability), member rates, complimentary Wi-Fi, Ultimate Reservation Guarantee. Silver normally requires 10 elite nights.

perks.name: 15 Elite Night Credits every calendar year
perks.details: Chase footnote: 15 Elite Night Credits deposited within 60 days of account opening, then on or before March 1 each subsequent calendar year. Bonvoy limits credit-card ENCs per member account: you can receive the 15 credits from only one personal Marriott card (holding Boundless plus Bold/Bountiful does not give 30), but secondary sources report that a Marriott Bonvoy Business card's 15 ENCs do stack with one personal card for up to 30 (not verified against Marriott terms). Elite tiers: Silver 10, Gold 25, Platinum 50, Titanium 75, Ambassador 100 nights + $23,000 annual spend.

perks.name: 1 Elite Night Credit per $5,000 in purchases (no cap)
perks.details: Earned on card purchases; posts to Bonvoy (allow up to 8 weeks). Stacks with the 15 annual credits; e.g., $50,000 of spend = 10 extra nights. Uncapped per Chase.

perks.name: Gold Elite status at $35,000 calendar-year spend
perks.details: Spend $35,000 on purchases in a calendar year (resets January 1) to receive Gold Elite for the following status year. Gold per marriott.com: 25% bonus points, 2 p.m. late checkout, enhanced room upgrade (best effort, excludes suites), welcome gift (points or F&B, varies by brand), Wi-Fi. Gold normally requires 25 elite nights. Note that 15 card ENCs + 10 actual nights also reach Gold, which for most Marriott loyalists is easier than $35,000 of spend.

perks.name: 12 months complimentary DashPass
perks.details: Activate for the first time with the Boundless card between 02/01/2025 and 12/31/2027 (card must be the default payment method in DoorDash, then click activate) to get 12 months of DashPass on DoorDash and Caviar ($0 delivery fees, reduced service fees). After the 12 free months you are automatically charged the then-current monthly DashPass rate until you cancel. Unlocks the $10 quarterly non-restaurant discount listed under credits.

perks.name: Current welcome offer (new cardmembers, as of Sept 2026)
perks.details: 3 Free Night Awards (each redeemable at hotels with a redemption level up to 50,000 points, top-up with up to 25,000 points) after $3,000 in purchases within 3 months of account opening, plus enrollment in the $100 airline credit offer (6/4/2026-6/30/2027). Not available if you currently hold or received a bonus on specified Marriott cards in the last 24 months (see gotchas). No public end date shown.

perks.name: Visa Signature Concierge
perks.details: 24/7 personal assistance (reservations, event planning) at 1-800-953-7392; you pay for any goods/services booked.

perks.name: Complimentary Wi-Fi at Marriott Bonvoy hotels
perks.details: Listed on the Chase benefits page for primary cardmembers; in practice this is the standard Bonvoy member/Silver Wi-Fi benefit.

perks.name: No authorized-user fee; Chase Offers; Refer-a-Friend
perks.details: Authorized users are free and their purchases earn points (and count toward the $6,000 cap and $5,000 ENC increments). Chase Offers give targeted merchant statement credits; Refer-a-Friend bonuses vary.

cards.acceptance: Visa Signature. Accepted essentially everywhere Visa is, including Costco warehouses in the U.S. (Costco accepts only Visa credit cards in-store; Costco fuel codes as warehouse club, not gas). No foreign transaction fee, chip and contactless enabled, works in Apple Pay/Google Pay/Samsung Pay. Visa is the most widely accepted network abroad. Digital-wallet or third-party-processor purchases only earn category bonuses if the underlying merchant code is in the category.
recentChanges: 2025-11-10: Marriott announced elite-status soft landings for 2026 (members who miss requalification drop only one tier, status valid through February 2027).

2026-01-15: Rewards Program Agreement RPA0513 revised (current version); earning structure unchanged: 6X Marriott, 3X first $6,000 combined gas/grocery/dining, 2X other.

2026-03-12: Marriott raised the Free Night Award top-up from 15,000 to 25,000 points, so the Boundless 35,000-point award now books nights priced up to 60,000 points (welcome-offer 50,000-point awards up to 75,000).

2026-07 (first week): Marriott quietly raised dynamic award prices across the portfolio, roughly 5-10% on average (some 2-16%; extremes like Mystique Santorini +36%); reduces the number of hotels bookable with the 35,000-point Free Night Award without a top-up and lowers per-point value (TPG now 0.75 cents, Sept 2026).
2026-09: Marriott Bonvoy Program Terms show 'Updated September 2026' (24-month inactivity expiration and brand base-earning tiers unchanged).
No annual fee change: $95 since the card's 2018 launch as Premier Plus/2019 rename; the Feb 2022 refresh that added 3X gas/grocery/dining and uncapped 1 ENC per $5,000 kept the fee at $95.
Announced end dates: airline credit ends 12/31/2026 (existing cardmembers) or 6/30/2027 (new cardmembers); DashPass/DoorDash benefits end 12/31/2027 unless renewed.
gotchas: The 3X categories share ONE $6,000 combined cap (about $18,000 in points, i.e., only 6,000 bonus points over the 2X base per year); after that gas/grocery/dining earn 2X. The cap year runs from your December statement date to the next December statement date, not the calendar year or cardmember anniversary.

Grocery excludes Walmart, Target, Costco/Sam's/BJ's, discount stores and drugstores; dining excludes restaurants inside hotels, casinos, stadiums, theme parks and grocery/department stores; only the seven named delivery apps count as dining. Warehouse-club gas is not 'gas stations'.

6X at Marriott is the card's portion only; the total you see (up to 17X) depends on brand (Residence Inn/TownePlace/Element etc. earn 5 base points, not 10) and on booking direct. OTA bookings earn card points as 'travel' at 2X (unless coded as Marriott) and no Bonvoy base points or elite nights.

The Free Night Award expires 12 months after deposit and Chase/Marriott will not extend it; it takes up to 8 weeks to appear after your anniversary, only covers a standard room, and does not cover resort/destination fees. Since July 2026 many hotels price just over 35,000, so budget up to 25,000 points for top-ups.

The $100 airline credit is a limited-time promotion, not a permanent benefit. Existing cardmembers had to activate; it pays only $50 per half-year window after $250 of DIRECT airline spend (no Expedia/Chase Travel), and Chase can claw it back if you close the account within 90 days.

DashPass auto-renews at the paid monthly rate after the 12 free months; set a reminder. The $10 quarterly DoorDash discount only works on non-restaurant orders while DashPass is active and any unused part of the $10 is forfeited.

Elite Night Credits from personal Marriott cards do not stack: holding Boundless and Bold/Bountiful still yields only 15 ENCs per year. Gold via spend needs $35,000 in a calendar year (resets Jan 1); 15 card ENCs plus 10 paid nights is usually the cheaper path to Gold.

cards.name: Bilt Palladium Card

currency.name: Bilt Points
currency.redemption: Transfer to 18 airlines at 1:1 (Aer Lingus, Air Canada Aeroplan, Air France-KLM Flying Blue, Alaska/Hawaiian Atmos Rewards, Avianca LifeMiles, British Airways, Cathay Pacific, Emirates, Etihad, Iberia, Japan Airlines, Qatar Privilege Club, Southwest, TAP, Turkish, United, Virgin Atlantic, Virgin Red); hotels: World of Hyatt 1:1 through 2026-12-31, then 4:3 (1,000 Bilt -> 750 Hyatt) from 2027-01-01 for all members and cards (announced 2026-10-01), Hilton 1:1, IHG 1:1, Marriott 1:1, Wyndham 1:1 (added 2026-03-25), Accor 3:2, I Prefer 1:2 (added 2026-06-22); rail: Amtrak Guest Rewards 2:1 (added 2026-09-23). Bilt Travel portal ~1.25 cents/point (secondary sources; official page not text-readable); statement credit toward Bilt Card balance (min 1,000 points; ~0.55 cents/point per Frequent Miler); rent/mortgage credit; home down payment ~1.5 cents; student loans ~1 cent; Lyft, fitness, Amazon (~0.7 cents). Points do not expire while account is active; all points are forfeited after 18 months of inactivity (no housing payment, Bilt Card purchase, redemption, or sweepstakes entry) or account closure. Third-party valuations: TPG 2.2 cents (Jan 2026); US Credit Card Guide 1.6 cents (Sep 2026).

housingRewards.description: Cardholder must pick ONE Rewards Option in the Bilt app; it applies to the whole account (incl. authorized users). Default if none chosen is Housing-only. Changes submitted during a billing cycle take effect the first day of the next billing cycle; option is locked for the cycle in which it is active. No transaction fee on rent/mortgage/HOA under either option. Housing payments must be made through the Bilt app/website with a linked bank account. Housing payments never earn Bilt Cash under either option.
housingRewards.housingPaymentDefinition: Eligible residential rent or mortgage payments made through Bilt, plus housing-related fees billed by the property manager/servicer (HOA dues, utilities, property taxes, amenity fees, gym fees).
housingRewards.everydaySpendDefinition: Eligible Purchases (incl. authorized users) that post within the billing cycle, excluding Bilt Housing Payments. Excluded from Eligible Purchases entirely (earn no points or Bilt Cash): balance transfers, cash advances/cash-like transactions, prepaid/gift cards, P2P payments (Venmo, PayPal, Cash App, Zelle), tax payments (except property taxes paid as part of a Bilt Housing Payment), crypto, card fees/interest, lottery/casino/wagers.

housingOnly.notes: Everyday Spend Ratio = Everyday Spend that posts in the billing cycle / Bilt Housing Payments that post in that same cycle. Calculated at statement close; housing points post after statement close. 250-point floor per billing cycle (primary cardholder only) when ratio < 25% and at least one housing payment was made. No monthly or annual cap on housing points. Returns reduce Everyday Spend in the cycle they post.

flexibleBiltCash.maxBiltCashUsablePerPayment: 0.03 x housing payment amount (e.g., $150 for a $5,000 payment -> 5,000 points)
flexibleBiltCash.timing: Cardholder chooses how much Bilt Cash to redeem (any amount from $0.03 up to the cap) each time a housing payment is made, in the payment flow. Not automatic and not retroactive; Bilt Cash accumulated from prior months (or the $200 annual / $300 welcome Bilt Cash) may be used. Unused Bilt Cash stays in the account for other redemptions.
flexibleBiltCash.notes: No 0x-1.25x tier and no 250-point floor under this option. Housing payments earn 0 points unless Bilt Cash is redeemed. If a housing payment is reversed, points are clawed back and the Bilt Cash is re-credited. Point Accelerator requires this option.

biltCash.description: Separate promotional currency (not points). Dollar-for-dollar toward specific Bilt-ecosystem credits with per-merchant monthly caps, or convertible to housing points at $0.03 per point. Has NO cash value: cannot be cashed out, deposited, or redeemed as a statement credit toward the card balance; non-transferable; forfeited on account closure; redemptions are final.

earning.source: 4% back on Everyday Spend (Flexible Bilt Cash option only; not earned under Housing-only; not earned on housing payments or excluded transactions)
$200 annual Palladium Bilt Cash benefit, credited at account open and every January 1 (account must be open and in good standing on Jan 1; not prorated)
$300 Bilt Cash welcome bonus at account open (one-time; no spend required)
$50 Bilt Cash per 25,000 Qualifying Points earned toward elite status in a calendar year (all Bilt members)

biltCash.expiration: Bilt Cash earned in a calendar year expires at the end of that year (Dec 31); up to $100 rolls over to the following year; used first-in-first-out (rolled-over Bilt Cash is spent first).

redemptions.name: Housing points unlock

redemptions.name: Point Accelerator

Excludes housing, tax payments, third-party payment/marketplace/mobile-reader merchants (Apple Pay/Google Pay OK). Not combinable with Rent Day double points (Bilt applies the better one).

earning.conditions: Flexible Bilt Cash option (yours): rent earns 0 points unless you redeem Bilt Cash at checkout — $3 of Bilt Cash per 100 points, max 1 point per $1 of rent. $5,000 rent → up to 5,000 points for $150 Bilt Cash. Each point costs 3¢, so this only beats spending Bilt Cash on credits if you value Bilt points above 3¢ (you value them at 1.5¢). Housing-only option instead earns 0–1.25x automatically based on your Everyday Spend Ratio but no Bilt Cash.
earning.notes: Rent, mortgage, HOA, property tax, utilities/fees billed by the landlord or servicer, paid through Bilt (ACH, check via BillPay, or Venmo to landlord; charge posts to the card and is auto-paid by the linked bank account within ~24 hours). No transaction fee under either option. Housing payments never earn Bilt Cash and do not count toward the welcome-bonus spend or elite-status Fast Track spend, but housing points DO count as Qualifying Points for status. Multiple properties allowed. See housingRewards for the full mechanism.

earning.conditions: 2x on all purchases except housing payments. Excluded: taxes, P2P (Venmo/PayPal/Zelle), gift cards, cash-like.
earning.notes: Excluded (no points, no Bilt Cash): balance transfers, cash advances and cash-like transactions, prepaid/gift cards, P2P payments (Venmo, PayPal, Cash App, Zelle), tax payments (except property tax within a Bilt housing payment), cryptocurrency, card fees/interest, lottery/casino/wagers, checks that access the account. Apple Pay/Google Pay/Samsung Pay purchases qualify. Points and Bilt Cash post 2-5 business days after the transaction posts. Rent Day (1st of month, through 2027-01-01): 4X on non-housing purchases, capped at 1,000 bonus points/month (i.e., first ~$500), Bilt Cash not doubled. Point Accelerator ($200 Bilt Cash) adds +1X on the next $5,000 (3X).

earning.conditions: 4% back in Bilt Cash on everyday spend (Flexible Bilt Cash option only; not on housing). Bilt Cash has no cash value: spend it dollar-for-dollar on Bilt Travel hotels ($100/mo at Gold+), Lyft/Walgreens/Grubhub ($10/mo each), Bilt Dining, fitness, or convert to rent points at 3¢ each. Expires Dec 31 ($100 rolls over).
earning.notes: Valued via the 'Bilt Cash' setting in Settings (per $1 of Bilt Cash).

earning.conditions: Hotels booked through Bilt Travel (biltrewards.com/travel or app): 2X base + 2X portal bonus = 4X. Flights booked through Bilt Travel or a Bilt Travel Advisor: 2X base + 1X bonus = 3X.
earning.notes: Portal bonus points are awarded only after the stay/flight is completed and only if the booking is paid entirely with the linked card: NO portal bonus if any portion is paid with Bilt Points, Bilt Cash, or the hotel travel credit (base 2X and 4% Bilt Cash still accrue on the net amount charged after credits). Airline-credit-funded portions earn no bonus.

earning.conditions: Base 2X at all restaurants. At Bilt Neighborhood Dining restaurants (20,000+ US restaurants shown in the app), an additional restaurant-specific bonus (typically 1X-3X) is earned when paying with any card linked to Bilt, for up to 5X total with the Palladium.
earning.notes: Bonus is on net spend excluding tips; excludes large parties/events and orders processed by third-party platforms; Bilt may withhold points on single transactions over $2,500. Rewards Network conflict: a card linked to another dining-rewards program will not earn Bilt Dining points at Rewards Network restaurants unless 'Enable Rewards' is toggled in the Bilt app (which unenrolls the other program). Bilt Cash dining credit ($25/visit, once a month) is a separate redemption via Bilt mobile checkout.

merchantRates.conditions: Link Bilt in the Lyft app; Bilt set as active loyalty partner; 2X base + 2X bonus on ride fare (excl. tips/taxes/fees/tolls)
merchantRates.notes: Program offer from 2026-02-07 'until terminated'. Lyft also accepts $10/month Bilt Cash credit.

merchantRates.conditions: 2X base + 1X bonus (4X on Walgreens-brand items); +100 points per prescription transaction up to 26/yr
merchantRates.notes: Offer valid on transactions from 2024-08-26; walgreens.com excluded.

merchantRates.conditions: 2X base + 1X Bilt x Metropolis bonus; link Metropolis account (auto-linked if same phone number); excludes airport, event, municipal, hospital lots
merchantRates.notes: Offer began 2025-10-21; 60 days' notice before termination.

credits.name: $200 annual Bilt Cash (spend before Dec 31; $100 rolls over)
credits.schedule: Credited to the Bilt Rewards account at account opening and on January 1 of each subsequent year the account is open and in good standing on that date; not prorated.
credits.howToUse: Arrives as Bilt Cash, not a statement credit. Spend it in the Bilt app (Wallet > Bilt Cash) on any Bilt Cash redemption; e.g., $200 unlocks 6,667 points on rent, or buys one Point Accelerator. It has no cash value and cannot be applied to the card balance. Subject to Bilt Cash expiration: expires Dec 31 of the year credited except $100 rollover.

credits.name: $400 Bilt Travel Hotel Credit ($200 semiannual)
credits.schedule: Up to $200 for bookings made Jan 1-Jun 30 and up to $200 for bookings made Jul 1-Dec 31 (11:59 PM PST cutoffs, by merchant processing date); $400 max per calendar year; unused halves do not roll over.
credits.howToUse: Primary cardholder books a hotel stay of 2 nights or more through Bilt Travel, pays with the Palladium, and toggles/opts in to apply the travel credit in the booking flow. Prepaid bookings: credit reduces the charge at checkout in real time. Pay-at-hotel bookings: credit posts as a statement credit after the stay, allow 8-10 weeks. The credit belongs to the period in which the booking is MADE, not the stay date. Refundable booking canceled in the same period: credit restored; canceled in a later period: credit forfeited; nonrefundable canceled: not refunded. Credit reversed if account closed within 90 days. Booking earns base points and Bilt Cash on the net amount after the credit, but NOT the +2X portal hotel bonus. Stackable with Bilt Cash ($50-$100/month by status) and points on the same booking.

rentalCar.limit: Lesser of actual repair cost, wholesale market value less salvage/depreciation, or rental agency purchase invoice; loss-of-use up to $500 per incident; towing to nearest repair facility
rentalCar.duration: Rentals of 31 consecutive days or less
rentalCar.notes: MasterRental (AIG/New Hampshire Insurance). Secondary to personal auto insurance and the rental company's CDW; becomes primary only where you have no other insurance or your insurance does not cover you outside the US. Must pay the entire rental with the card (and/or points), decline the rental company's CDW/LDW, rent in your own name. Worldwide except where prohibited. Excluded vehicles: trucks/pickups, full-size and cargo vans, campers/RVs, off-road vehicles, sport utility trucks, motorcycles/<4 wheels, antiques >20 years old, limousines. Does not cover liability, injury, personal items, keys, GPS. Report within 60 days; documents within 180 days (per Upgraded Points).

purchaseProtection.notes: Mastercard Purchase Assurance: damaged or stolen items within 90 days of purchase; item must be bought entirely with the card and/or points; secondary to other insurance; gifts covered; pairs/sets limited to the damaged item; jewelry/fine art limited to statement price.

extendedWarranty.notes: Doubles the original US manufacturer's or store warranty of 24 months or less, up to a maximum of 24 additional months; also extends a purchased service contract of 24 months or less. Max benefit per claim: lesser of purchase price, repair cost, replacement cost, or $10,000. Secondary coverage. Item must be paid entirely with the card (or card + points).

returnProtection.notes: Not included in the Palladium Guide to Benefits.

cellPhone.conditions: Must charge the monthly wireless bill to the Palladium; coverage starts the first day of the month after a paid bill and is suspended for any month after a bill is not paid with the card. Covers theft (police report within 48 hours) and damage; not mysterious disappearance. Excess of any other insurance. Covers primary and supplemental lines on the bill.

tripDelay.notes: One claim per 12 months. Common-carrier delay >6 hours due to weather, carrier equipment failure, or lost/stolen passport/travel documents; no coverage if the carrier cancels within 6 hours of departure. Trip must be purchased entirely with the card (award tickets: remaining taxes/fees on the card). Covers cardholder, family members, traveling companions. Secondary to carrier compensation.

tripCancellation.notes: Trip Cancellation and Interruption: reimburses nonrefundable common-carrier fares (not hotels/tours) charged to the card, $2,000 per covered trip and $5,000 per account per 12 months; covered losses include illness/injury/death of traveler or family member, severe weather, etc.; secondary to carrier refunds/vouchers.

baggageDelay.notes: Checked baggage delayed 6+ hours: emergency replacement of personal/business articles up to $250 per claim, 2 claims per 12 months; entire ticket must be bought with the card and/or points.

lostLuggage.notes: Lost or Damaged Luggage: checked or carry-on luggage and contents, up to $1,500 per incident, 2 claims per 12 months; 'lost' = missing 10 consecutive days; secondary to carrier compensation; worldwide.

travelAccident.notes: No common-carrier travel accident insurance in the Palladium Guide to Benefits.

travelEmergencyAssistance.notes: No medical/emergency evacuation benefit. Mastercard Global Service (24-hour lost/stolen card reporting, emergency card replacement and cash advance) is included.

perks.name: Price protection
perks.details: Price Drop Protection 90-Day: reimburses the difference if the identical item (same manufacturer/model) is advertised lower by a non-auction merchant within 90 days; up to $250 per claim, $25 minimum, 4 claims per 12 months; excludes jewelry, art, used/refurbished items, items for resale/commercial use. Up to $250/claim.

perks.name: Priority Pass Select lounge membership
perks.details: Complimentary membership for the primary cardholder with up to 2 free guests per visit; additional guests $35 each charged to the card (Bilt Cash can reimburse up to 2 extra guests/month, $70). Access via QR code in the Bilt app with no activation, or activate at prioritypass.com with the membership ID (existing Priority Pass accounts from other cards will not work; create a new one). 1,700+ lounges (Bilt markets 1,300+). Authorized users ($95) reportedly receive their own membership with 2 guests (Upgraded Points, secondary). Priority Pass restaurant/dining credits reportedly excluded (Frequent Miler, secondary; not stated in the Guide to Benefits).

perks.name: No transaction fee on rent/mortgage/HOA paid through Bilt
perks.details: All housing payments through Bilt (ACH to landlord portal, mailed check via BillPay, or Venmo) post to the card with no fee under either Rewards Option; the charge is repaid from the linked bank account within ~24 hours. Housing spend counts toward the credit limit while pending.

perks.name: Rent Day double points (through 2027-01-01)
perks.details: On the 1st of each month (12:00 AM ET-11:59 PM PT), Palladium earns 4X (2 base + 2 bonus) on non-housing net purchases, max 1,000 bonus points per month per Bilt account (~$500 of spend). Bilt Cash is not doubled; housing points not doubled. Excludes tax payments, third-party payment accounts/marketplaces/mobile card readers (Apple Pay allowed). Cannot be combined with Point Accelerator (Bilt applies whichever earns more). Effective 2026-03-01 through 2027-01-01.

perks.name: Rent Day transfer bonuses (monthly, status-tiered)
perks.details: Each Rent Day features transfer bonuses to one or more partners, tiered by Bilt status (Oct 2026 example: Hilton 75%/100%/150%/175% for Blue/Silver/Gold/Platinum, up to 200% with a $200 Bilt Cash buy-up; Amtrak 25%-100%, $400 buy-up to 125%; 100,000-point transfer cap per promo; Oct 2026 also adds a 90-day Hilton status challenge). Rent Day also often includes status matches and category bonuses.

perks.name: Point Accelerator
perks.details: Redeem $200 Bilt Cash for +1X on the next $5,000 of eligible purchases (3X everyday), up to 5 times per calendar year; Flexible Bilt Cash option required; expires Dec 31 of activation year.

perks.name: Bilt Gold Elite Status via welcome bonus
perks.details: Gold after $4,000 Everyday Spend in 90 days; valid remainder of year, all of next year, through Jan 15 of the year after. Gold benefits include 1,000-point transfer minimum, elevated Rent Day transfer bonuses, monthly interest on the points balance, $100/month Bilt Cash hotel-portal cap, $150 x2 Equinox Bilt Cash credits, $100 Blacklane credit, BLADE lounge access, Home Away From Home hotel collection, travel and home-buying concierge.

perks.name: Mastercard World Legend benefits

Merchant offers at mastercard.com/us/worldlegend could not be fetched (403); treat any specific merchant credits as unverified.

perks.name: 10.00% introductory purchase APR

perks.name: Bilt Elite Status program

Qualifying Points include housing points and card points (exclude referrals, courtesy, campaign bonuses); Fast Track spend excludes housing. Status valid for the rest of the year earned, the following year, and through Jan 15 after that. All members earn $50 Bilt Cash per 25,000 Qualifying Points.

You must actively pick the Flexible Bilt Cash option; the default is Housing-only, which earns NO Bilt Cash on everyday spend. Changes take effect the first day of the NEXT billing cycle, so a switch mid-cycle does not affect the current cycle.

Under Flexible Bilt Cash, rent earns zero points unless you redeem Bilt Cash in the payment flow at the time of the payment. It is not automatic and cannot be applied retroactively to a past rent payment.

Unlock math: $0.03 of Bilt Cash per point, capped at 1 point per $1 of housing. For $5,000 rent you need $150 Bilt Cash per month to get the full 5,000 points, which requires $3,750 of everyday spend at 4% (the $200 annual Bilt Cash covers about 1.3 months).

Break-even: converting Bilt Cash to housing points is only better than spending it dollar-for-dollar on merchant credits if you value Bilt Points above 3.0 cents each. At TPG's 2.2 cents, $150 of Bilt Cash buys 5,000 points worth ~$110, versus $150 face value at Lyft/Walgreens/Bilt Travel (but those outlets have small monthly caps).
Bilt Cash expires Dec 31 of the year earned except $100 that rolls over (FIFO). Front-loaded $200 annual + $300 welcome + 4% earnings can pile up; plan redemptions before year-end.
Bilt Cash cannot be cashed out or applied as a statement credit to the card balance; it is only spendable inside the Bilt ecosystem, and it is forfeited if the Bilt account closes.
Tax payments, P2P payments (Venmo/PayPal/Zelle/Cash App), gift cards and prepaid cards earn no points and no Bilt Cash (property tax bundled into the Bilt housing payment is the exception).

Housing payments never earn Bilt Cash, do not count toward the $4,000 welcome-bonus spend, and do not count toward Fast Track (spend-based) status; housing points DO count as Qualifying Points for status.

Hotel credit: 2-night minimum, Bilt Travel Portal only, must opt in at checkout, credited by booking date (not stay date) into the Jan-Jun or Jul-Dec half; pay-at-hotel bookings take 8-10 weeks to post as a statement credit; canceling in a later half forfeits the credit.
Any Bilt Travel booking partly paid with Bilt Cash, points, or the hotel credit loses the +2X/+1X portal bonus (base 2X and 4% Bilt Cash still accrue on the net card charge).

Priority Pass: a Priority Pass account linked to another card will not work; create a new one, or just use the QR code in the Bilt app. Extra guests beyond 2 cost $35 (reimbursable with Bilt Cash up to 2/month).

Point Accelerator requires the Flexible option, applies to one selected card only, excludes housing/tax/third-party payment merchants, and expires Dec 31 - activate early in the year. It also does not stack with Rent Day double points.
Rent Day 4X is capped at 1,000 bonus points (about $500 of spend) and Bilt Cash is NOT doubled.

Rental car coverage is secondary in the US (primary only abroad where you have no other coverage); trip delay is only $300 and one claim per year; trip cancellation covers common-carrier fares only, not hotels.
Cell phone protection requires paying the wireless bill with the card every month; a skipped month suspends coverage the following month.

Welcome bonus is once per lifetime across all Bilt 2.0 cards; downgrading within 30 days of the annual fee posting claws back credits and bonuses; only one voluntary product change per rolling 12 months.

Authorized users cost $95 each; the primary cardholder chooses whether AU-earned points/Bilt Cash go to the primary's or the AU's Bilt account. Under Flexible, an AU unlocking housing points uses the AU's own Bilt Cash balance.
Points are lost after 18 months with no housing payment, Bilt Card purchase, redemption, or sweepstakes entry.
Statement-credit redemption of points is poor value (~0.55 cents); transfers to Hyatt/airlines or the 1.25-cent travel portal are the intended uses.
Mastercard is not accepted at US Costco warehouses (Visa only in-store).
Hyatt transfers are 1:1 only through 2026-12-31; from 2027-01-01 they become 4:3 (33% more Bilt points per Hyatt point). Transfer any points earmarked for Hyatt before year-end.

dateBonus.label: Rent Day (1st of the month): 4x on non-housing purchases today, up to 1,000 bonus points (through Jan 1, 2027)

cards.name: Wells Fargo Autograph Card (Wells Fargo Autograph Visa Card)

currency.name: Wells Fargo Rewards
currency.redemption: 1 point = $0.01 for every cash-style redemption: Redeem for Purchases (statement credit against a specific past purchase; transaction must be $1 or more and you must have enough points to cover the ENTIRE transaction; credit posts in 5-7 business days), Redeem to Account (credit to an eligible Wells Fargo credit card or checking/savings account), Wells Fargo ATM redemption with a WF debit card (secondary sources: $20 minimum, $20 increments), gift cards (e-gift cards from $10; 250+ merchants), Pay with Rewards at PayPal checkout (no points earned on the redeemed portion; PWR sharing preference must be enabled), and Wells Fargo Travel portal bookings (flights, hotels, car rentals at 1 cent/point; cruise bookings through the portal were discontinued June 30, 2026). Secondary sources report a $25 (2,500-point) minimum for general cash redemptions to an account; not confirmed in the official summary terms. Points Transfer (online only, any amount, no minimum, no increment requirement, transfers are final, most post within minutes): 1:1 to Aer Lingus AerClub, Air France-KLM Flying Blue, Avianca LifeMiles, The British Airways Club, Cathay Pacific (Cathay/Asia Miles, added Apr 28 2026), Iberia Club, JetBlue TrueBlue (added Oct 27/Nov 4 2025), Virgin Atlantic Flying Club / Virgin Red (same Virgin Points currency; some sources count them separately); 1:2 to Choice Privileges and Wyndham Rewards (added Apr 15 2026). The standard no-annual-fee Autograph has the SAME transfer partners and ratios as Autograph Journey (Wells Fargo press releases name both cards and say transfers are available on all WF cards that earn rewards points). Points do not expire while the account is open; closing all rewards-eligible WF cards forfeits points (New York residents receive a check). Bonus-category points post 1-2 months after earning; welcome bonus shows as redeemable within 60 days. Since June 2026 rewards balances are no longer AUTOMATICALLY combined across multiple WF cards (each card shows its own balance), but you can still manually move rewards between your own WF card accounts (e.g., Active Cash cash rewards into Autograph points before transferring), per Frequent Miler/Miles to Memories reporting of the WF notice; gifting points to other cardholders and automatic redemptions ended September 25, 2026.

earning.conditions: None (no cap, no activation). Merchant must be coded under Visa food/drink MCCs.
earning.notes: Issuer definition ('Food/Drink Establishments'): caterers, drinking places (bars), eating places and restaurants, fast food restaurants. Terms say purchases may NOT earn bonus at bakeries, grocery stores and other miscellaneous places that serve food or operate restaurants on site, and third-party delivery services. Note the conflict: the marketing page says 'dining in, take-out, catering, delivery and more' but the Rewards Terms list third-party delivery services (e.g., DoorDash/Grubhub/Uber Eats when coded as delivery) as possibly not earning bonus; delivery ordered directly from a restaurant coded as a restaurant does count.

earning.conditions: None (no cap; no portal required).
earning.notes: Issuer 'Travel' category: airlines, hotels/motels, campgrounds, timeshares, cruise lines, travel agencies, discount travel sites (OTAs such as Expedia/Booking.com/Priceline), vehicle/auto rentals. No exclusions listed. Includes the Wells Fargo Travel portal (operated by a travel agency). Does NOT include transit-type merchants (see transit) or Airbnb-style lodging unless coded as travel.

earning.conditions: None.
earning.notes: Part of the issuer's single 'Travel' category (airlines). Listed separately here for tool matching; identical terms to travel.

earning.conditions: None.
earning.notes: Part of the issuer's 'Travel' category (hotel/motels, timeshares, campgrounds). Identical terms to travel.

earning.conditions: None.
earning.notes: Part of the issuer's 'Travel' category (vehicle/auto rentals). Identical terms to travel.

earning.conditions: Booked through Wells Fargo Travel (wellsfargo.com/redeem); 1 cent/point redemption value; email address on file required for travel bookings since June 30, 2026.
earning.notes: Wells Fargo Travel bookings fall under the Travel category (travel agency), so 3X, not an elevated portal rate (unlike Autograph Journey). Portal also gives access to Preferred Partner Hotels perks (breakfast for two, upgrades, early check-in/late checkout when available) per The Points Guy. Rate on portal bookings confirmed by TPG; not spelled out separately in official terms.

earning.conditions: None (no cap).
earning.notes: Issuer 'Fuel/Charging Stations' category: gas stations, automated fuel dispensers, electric vehicle charging stations. Terms say gas or EV-charging purchases may NOT earn bonus at auto repair stores, superstores (e.g., Walmart/Target fuel), car washes, warehouse/membership clubs (Costco, Sam's Club, BJ's), grocery stores (supermarket fuel centers coded as grocery).

earning.conditions: None.
earning.notes: Electric vehicle charging stations are explicitly included in the 3X Fuel/Charging Stations category (same exclusions as gas: charging at superstores, warehouse clubs, grocery stores may not count).

earning.conditions: None (no cap).
earning.notes: Issuer 'Transport' category in the Rewards Terms: ferries, parking lots and garages, limousines, taxis, passenger railway, toll bridges and highways. The official card page markets it as 'subways, ride shares, parking, tolls and more'. Note the Terms' list does not literally name local/suburban commuter transit (subways/buses); Wells Fargo's marketing says subways count, so treat public transit as expected-but-merchant-coding-dependent. Rideshare (Uber/Lyft) is covered via taxis/limousines coding. Wells Fargo reserves the right to decide what qualifies based on merchant coding.

earning.conditions: None.
earning.notes: Wells Fargo's card page names 'ride shares' in the 3X Transit category; Uber and Lyft rides code as taxi/limousine MCCs listed in the Terms. Uber Eats is not transit (see dining note re: third-party delivery).

earning.conditions: Must be billed directly by the streaming service and coded under the Visa categories below; bundled or third-party-billed subscriptions may not earn 3X.
earning.notes: Issuer 'Entertainment' category: books, music, continuity/subscription services, streaming services considered cable and other pay television, digital goods, movies. Exclusions in Terms: streaming services bundled with another product, membership, or service (e.g., Amazon Prime Video within Prime; Disney bundle via Verizon); streaming services that a third party bills, such as a digital platform (Apple App Store / Google Play billing), a cable, telecommunications, or internet provider, an online retailer, or an in-vehicle streaming service (SiriusXM in-car). Wells Fargo publishes NO named list of eligible services: wellsfargo.com/autographstreaming (disclosure DT1-07142026, checked Sept 2026) only lists the category types above. Netflix, Hulu, Disney+, Max, Spotify, YouTube TV, etc. generally earn 3X when billed directly.

earning.conditions: Charge must be from a merchant coded as a telecommunication service provider.
earning.notes: Issuer 'Telecommunication Services' category: landline and cell phone providers (Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, etc.; landline/VoIP providers also count). Exclusions in Terms: additional phone services such as insurance or additional data (when billed separately), phones and accessories, phone-plan services that a third party bundles or bills (e.g., an internet provider bundle or in-vehicle service). Prepaid/MVNO carriers (Mint, Google Fi, Visible, Cricket) are not addressed by Wells Fargo; they usually code as telecom (MCC 4814) and would then earn 3X, but this is unverified. Paying the bill with the card is also what activates Cellular Telephone Protection.

earning.conditions: Net purchases only.
earning.notes: No points on cash advances/equivalents (ATM, money orders, prepaid gift cards, P2P transfers, wire transfers, digital currencies), balance transfers, fees/interest, disputed/illegal purchases, or gambling transactions (bets, casino chips, lottery). Amounts rounded to the nearest whole dollar per transaction.

rentalCar.limit: $50,000 maximum; covers repair cost or actual cash value (lesser), reasonable towing to nearest repair facility, loss of use, additional fees/taxes; covers deductibles under your own policy
rentalCar.duration: Rental periods up to 15 consecutive days in the US and 31 consecutive days outside the US
rentalCar.notes: Secondary in the United States; primary outside the United States where available (even if you have another policy). Must pay the entire rental with the card and/or Wells Fargo Rewards points, and decline the rental company's collision loss/damage waiver. Not available in Israel, Jamaica, Republic of Ireland, Northern Ireland. Excluded: exotic cars (Aston Martin, Bentley, Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati, Porsche, Rolls Royce, etc.), antiques (over 20 years old or not manufactured for 10+ years), vans other than small-group vans seating up to 9, open-cargo-bed vehicles, trucks, motorcycles/mopeds, limousines, RVs, vehicles rented with a driver, peer-to-peer car-sharing rentals (Turo-type), cars used for hire. Does not cover liability, injury, third-party property, or diminished value. Notify within 60 days; documents within 365 days. Administered by Assurant (Virginia Surety Company), 1-800-316-8051.

purchaseProtection.notes: Not in the Autograph Guide to Benefits (effective 09/15/2025). Confirmed absent by Upgraded Points and WalletHub.

extendedWarranty.notes: Not in the Autograph Guide to Benefits. Confirmed absent by Upgraded Points, WalletHub, Bankrate.

cellPhone.conditions: You must pay the monthly wireless bill with the card, and the bill charge must post to the account in the month immediately preceding the damage/theft. Coverage starts the first day of the calendar month after the first bill posts; it is suspended for any month following a month in which the bill was not charged to the card and resumes the month after the next charge. Covers all phone lines on the wireless bill (cardholder need not be the line owner). Reimburses repair or replacement at current market value, less $25 deductible, up to $600 per claim, max 2 paid claims and $1,200 per 12 months. Excludes: lost/mysteriously disappeared phones, cracked screens or cosmetic damage that do not affect function, tablets, smartwatches and non-phone devices on the bill, accessories, phones bought for resale/commercial use, phones in the custody of a carrier/shipper, electronic/software failure, Acts of God. Coverage is supplemental/secondary to other insurance (carrier insurance, homeowner's/renter's, AppleCare-type coverage). Notify within 60 days; documents within 120 days; claim finalized within 15 business days of complete documentation. Administrator Assurant, 1-800-316-8051, mycardbenefits.assurant.com.

tripCancellation.notes: Not offered (no trip cancellation or interruption insurance).

lostLuggage.notes: No lost-luggage reimbursement. Only a 'Lost Luggage Locator Service' (assistance with the carrier's claim process) under Travel and Emergency Assistance Services; cardholder pays any costs.

travelAccident.notes: No travel accident / common-carrier accident insurance.

roadsideAssistance.notes: Roadside Dispatch: PAY-PER-USE, not free. No membership or pre-enrollment, no limit on usage. For a set price per service call (fee confirmed when you call; secondary sources report about $79.95): standard towing up to 5 miles, tire change (must have inflated spare), jump start, lockout service (no key replacement), fuel delivery up to 5 gallons plus cost of fuel, standard winching within 100 feet of a paved/county road. Light-duty vehicles (10,000 lbs or less) only; mileage over 5 miles billed by the provider; may not be available in all areas. Call 1-800-847-2869.

travelEmergencyAssistance.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services (Visa): 24/7 referral and coordination only, no reimbursement. Emergency message relay, medical and legal referral, emergency transportation and ticket replacement assistance, lost luggage locator, emergency translation, prescription/valuable document delivery arrangements, pre-trip information. Cardholder pays all actual costs. Covers the cardholder and dependents under 22 per the guide summary. Call 1-800-992-6029 (US) or collect 1-804-673-1675.

perks.name: Visa Signature Concierge
perks.details: Complimentary 24/7 concierge (1-800-953-7392) for travel booking, event tickets, dinner reservations, golf tee times; cardholder pays for anything purchased.

perks.name: Visa Signature Luxury Hotel Collection
perks.details: When booked through VisaSignatureHotels.com or Visa Concierge: best available rate guarantee, automatic room upgrade on arrival when available, complimentary in-room Wi-Fi, complimentary breakfast for two, $25 food/beverage credit, VIP guest status, late check-out on request. Resort fees not reimbursable; hotels may substitute benefits.

perks.name: My Wells Fargo Deals
perks.details: Card-linked merchant offers (like Chase Offers/Amex Offers). You must activate each deal online/in app and pay the merchant directly with the card before the deal expires; cash back posts as an account credit within 60 days. Paying via digital wallet, third-party provider, or a mobile card reader may disqualify the deal. Credits reverse if the purchase is returned.

perks.name: Autograph Card Exclusives
perks.details: Ticket access to small-venue concerts by major artists for Wells Fargo cardholders, with Autograph-branded cardholders getting first access (other WF cardholders about 3 days later). Per AwardWallet (Jul 2026): tickets about $100 incl. fees, limit 4 per household, early entry, 30% merchandise discount with the card, complimentary gift. 2026 events: Fall Out Boy (San Francisco), Alanis Morissette (Houston), Benson Boone (NYC, Sept 10, 2026). Must pay with an eligible Wells Fargo credit card during the sales window; first come, first served. See entertainment.wf.com.

perks.name: Wells Fargo Travel portal Preferred Partner Hotels
perks.details: Booking select luxury hotels through Wells Fargo Travel gives breakfast for two, room upgrades, early check-in and late checkout when available; TPG reports the no-annual-fee Autograph is eligible. Not described in Wells Fargo's own Autograph materials.

perks.name: 0% intro APR on purchases
perks.details: 0% intro APR for 12 months from account opening on purchases; then 18.74%, 24.74% or 28.74% variable (as of Sept 2026). No intro APR on balance transfers; BT fee $5 or 3% for first 120 days, then 5%.

perks.name: Credit Close-Up (free FICO Score)
perks.details: Monthly FICO Score updates and credit insights for Wells Fargo Online customers; enrollment required.

perks.name: Emergency Cash Disbursement and Card Replacement / Zero Liability
perks.details: Visa Global Customer Care (1-800-708-8217) can arrange an emergency cash advance or replacement card within 1-3 business days (sometimes 24 hours); cash advance fees/interest apply. Zero liability for promptly reported unauthorized transactions.

perks.name: Welcome offer (Sept 2026)
perks.details: 20,000 bonus points ($200 cash value) after $1,000 in net purchases in the first 3 months; posts within 60 days of earning. Standard public offer since early 2024 (a 30,000-point offer existed in 2022-2023). Wells Fargo generally does not approve a new bonus if you opened the same card within the last 48 months.

cards.acceptance: Visa Signature. Accepted essentially everywhere Visa is, including Costco warehouses and Costco gas stations in the US (Costco accepts only Visa among credit card networks in-store). No foreign transaction fee, so usable abroad at no surcharge. Visa Signature (not Visa Infinite) tier of benefits.

Benefit set unchanged in substance: Cellular Telephone Protection ($600/claim, $1,200 and 2 claims per 12 months, $25 deductible), Auto Rental CDW (secondary in US), Roadside Dispatch (pay-per-use), Travel & Emergency Assistance, Visa Signature Concierge and Luxury Hotel Collection. No purchase protection, extended warranty or trip insurance.

2025-10-27 / 2025-11-04: JetBlue TrueBlue added as a 1:1 transfer partner (transfers went live Oct 27 per Doctor of Credit; Wells Fargo press release Nov 4, 2025). Press release confirms the standard Autograph Card is eligible.
