Converted accounts earn standard Autograph rewards (no Bilt Rewards) and get the standard Autograph benefits (cell phone protection drops from $800 to $600 per claim; far fewer transfer partners than Bilt).
2025-12-30: Summary of Wells Fargo Rewards Program Terms and Autograph Addendum effective date (current version as of Sept 2026). Category definitions unchanged from prior versions.
2026-02: The Points Guy named the Autograph its 2026 No-Annual-Fee Credit Card of the Year (recognition, not a product change).

2026-04-15: Wyndham Rewards added as a 1:2 transfer partner (second hotel partner). Press release: available on all Wells Fargo cards that earn rewards points, including Autograph and Autograph Journey.
2026-04-28: Cathay Pacific (Cathay/Asia Miles) added as a 1:1 transfer partner. Total now 10 programs (8 airline, 2 hotel), 11 if Virgin Red is counted separately from Virgin Atlantic Flying Club.

2026-06 (notice dated ~June 7-10, 2026): Wells Fargo Rewards balances are no longer automatically combined across multiple WF cards (each card keeps its own balance); manually moving rewards between your OWN cards (e.g., Active Cash cash rewards into Autograph points) remains possible per Frequent Miler and Miles to Memories (correction 2026-10-02 of earlier wording that said pooling was no longer possible). Travel redemption provider changed to Aspire Lifestyles (AMERICAS) Inc.; cruise bookings through the rewards travel portal discontinued; email address on file required for travel bookings effective June 30, 2026.
2026-09-25: Automatic redemptions and gifting of rewards to other cardholders discontinued.
Welcome offer: 20,000 points after $1,000 in 3 months has been the standard public offer throughout 2025-2026 (no elevated public offer seen; a 30,000-point offer existed in late 2023).
gotchas: Third-party delivery (DoorDash, Grubhub, Uber Eats, Instacart) is listed in the Rewards Terms as possibly NOT earning the 3X dining bonus even though marketing says 'delivery'; order directly from the restaurant to be safe.

Gas at Costco, Sam's Club, BJ's, Walmart/Target fuel centers and supermarket fuel stations is excluded from 3X (superstores, warehouse clubs, grocery stores). Same applies to EV charging at those locations.

Streaming only earns 3X when the streaming service bills you directly. Subscriptions billed through the Apple App Store/Google Play, Amazon (online retailer), your cable/internet/phone carrier bundle, or in-car (SiriusXM) may not count. Wells Fargo publishes no list of named eligible services.

Phone plans: device installment payments, insurance and add-ons billed separately, phones and accessories, and carrier service bundled by an ISP may not earn 3X. Prepaid/MVNO carriers are not addressed by Wells Fargo.

Transit per the Terms is ferries, parking, limousines, taxis, passenger rail, tolls; marketing adds subways and rideshare. Whether a specific transit agency earns 3X depends on its Visa merchant code.

Cell phone protection only works if your monthly wireless bill was charged to this card in the month immediately before the incident; skipping a month suspends coverage. $25 deductible, $600/claim, 2 claims and $1,200 per 12 months, excludes lost phones and non-functional-impact cracked screens, and pays only after other insurance (carrier plan, AppleCare, renter's). Tablets and watches on the bill are not covered.

Rental car coverage is SECONDARY in the US (primary only abroad). You must decline the rental company's CDW/LDW and pay the entire rental with the card or points. Turo/peer-to-peer rentals, trucks, exotics, and rentals over 15 days (US) are excluded; not valid in Israel, Jamaica, Ireland, Northern Ireland.

Do not assume Visa Signature extras: this card has NO purchase protection, extended warranty, price/return protection, trip delay, trip cancellation/interruption, baggage delay, lost luggage reimbursement, or travel accident insurance.
Roadside Dispatch is not free roadside assistance; you pay a per-call fee (about $79.95 per secondary sources) plus mileage over 5 miles.

Redeem for Purchases requires enough points to cover the ENTIRE selected transaction ($1 minimum); general cash redemptions to an account reportedly have a $25 minimum and ATM redemptions are in $20 increments. Bonus-category points post 1-2 months after the purchase.

Points transfers are online only and irreversible; partner program rules (e.g., Flying Blue dynamic pricing, BA/Iberia/Aer Lingus Avios household rules) apply after transfer. Choice and Wyndham are 1:2, everything else 1:1.

As of June 2026 rewards from different WF cards are no longer pooled automatically (you must move them manually between your own cards before transferring), and since Sept 25, 2026 you can no longer gift points to another cardholder or set up automatic redemptions.
My Wells Fargo Deals require activating each deal and paying the merchant directly with the physical/virtual card number; digital wallet or third-party payment may not qualify.
Wells Fargo typically will not pay a welcome bonus if you opened the same card in the last 48 months, and Autograph product changes to/from other WF cards have historically been unavailable.

cards.name: Apple Card

currency.name: Daily Cash
currency.redemption: Cash back, calculated per posted purchase (rounded to nearest cent, minimum 1 cent) and automatically transferred at least once every business day to the cardholder's Daily Cash Election: either an Apple Cash account (Green Dot Bank) or an Apple Card Savings account (Goldman Sachs Bank USA, 3.50% APY as of 2026-09-23). Daily Cash cannot be split between the two. If no election is set, Daily Cash accrues on the card account and can be redeemed as a statement credit (counts as a payment); on account closure any accrued balance is credited or paid out. No caps, no minimum redemption, no expiration; it never loses value. Returns, disputes and merchant credits trigger a Daily Cash Adjustment (clawback) charged to the account. Apple Card Family participants can only receive Daily Cash to Apple Cash (not Savings); under-18 participants need an Apple Cash Family account set up by the family organizer.

earning.conditions: Purchases made directly from Apple with Apple Card by any method (Apple Pay, titanium card, or virtual card number). Includes Apple Card Monthly Installments purchases (3% paid up front on the full purchase price).
earning.notes: Per Customer Agreement: Apple retail stores, the Apple online store, iTunes, Apple Music and other Apple-owned properties, App Store purchases including in-app purchases and subscriptions. EXCLUDES Apple goods/services bought through third-party retailers or Apple authorized resellers (e.g. Best Buy, Amazon, carriers), and any payment made through a third-party wallet. Not stackable: a purchase at Apple via Apple Pay earns 3%, not 3%+2%. Also 3% on Apple Upgrade lease payments made with Apple Card (Apple's Klarna-backed leasing program for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, launched in the US 2026-07-28; it replaced the iPhone Upgrade Program). Apple Card Monthly Installments remain available alongside it.

earning.conditions: Apple Pay required (in store, in app, or on the web with Apple Pay checkout) using Apple Card as the selected card.
earning.notes: Customer Agreement: 'Apple Pay Purchase Transactions: 2% of the transaction amount.' Apple says Apple Pay is accepted at about 85% of US merchants. Notable holdouts where Apple Card therefore earns 1% or cannot be used: merchants without contactless terminals; Costco US warehouses do not accept Mastercard credit at all.

earning.conditions: Physical titanium card (swipe/chip/tap with the card itself) or the virtual card number entered online/in app without Apple Pay; also any payment through a third-party wallet.
earning.notes: Customer Agreement: 'All other Purchase Transactions: 1% of the transaction amount.' Apple support explicitly states the 3% partner-merchant bonus is NOT offered for purchases made with the titanium card or the virtual card number. No Daily Cash on cash advances/cash equivalents (prohibited by the agreement), purchases for resale, fees or interest.

merchantRates.conditions: US only; Apple Card with Apple Pay at acehardware.com, in the Ace Hardware app, or at participating stores listed at acehardware.com/applecard.
merchantRates.notes: Excludes online and mobile-app gift card purchases and purchases from third-party merchants using independent point-of-sale systems inside an Ace store. Not every Ace store participates (independently owned). Partner since 2022-04-19.

merchantRates.conditions: US only; must book through the exclusive link booking.com/apple-card (or the link in Wallet > Rewards & Offers), pay in advance directly to Booking.com using an eligible rate type, and pay with Apple Card via Apple Pay.
merchantRates.notes: Eligible: stays paid in full to Booking.com before check-in ('Pay now', 'Pay later' if paid to Booking.com before check-in, 'Pay part now, part later' etc.) and car rentals on 'Pay now' or the 'pay now' portion of 'Pay part now, part later'. NOT eligible: 'Pay at the property', 'Pay when you stay', 'Pay at pickup', 'Partner Offer' rates; flights, flight+hotel packages, cruises, attractions, airport taxis; amounts paid to the property or rental company; corporate/B2B/white-label sites; bookings from a non-US IP address; bookings in the Booking.com app or site without the exclusive link may not qualify. Look for the 'Apple Card Benefits' badge. Additional perk fulfilled by Booking.com: 2% Booking.com Travel Credits on eligible bookings (earned after stay completes, usable only on future Booking.com bookings) and fast-track to Genius Level 2 after one eligible stay/rental. Added 2024-11-19.

merchantRates.conditions: Apple Card with Apple Pay for EV charging at public ChargePoint stations via the ChargePoint app, contactless readers at the station, or the ChargePoint Wallet pass; and home charger purchases at ChargePoint.com.
merchantRates.notes: Not valid at private charging stations, fleet services, commercial hardware/software, ChargePoint support services (Assure/AssurePro) or third-party hardware. Added 2024-11-19.

merchantRates.conditions: New York and New Jersey stores (Walgreens-owned); Apple Card with Apple Pay in store, in the Walgreens app, or online.
merchantRates.notes: Same exclusions as Walgreens: gift cards (online/in-app), drive-thru purchases, online or in-app orders with more than one item in the cart, third-party kiosks/services inside stores (telecom, photo, dental, optical, healthcare, lab, hearing), and orders placed on third-party delivery apps/sites.

merchantRates.conditions: US only; Apple Card with Apple Pay at Exxon-branded pumps (via the Exxon Mobil Rewards+ app or contactless at the pump) and attached convenience stores; includes fuel, convenience store and car wash purchases.
merchantRates.notes: Excludes online gift card purchases and third-party merchants located at an Exxon site, including independent car washes. Many pumps lack contactless readers; use the Exxon Mobil Rewards+ app with Apple Pay to guarantee 3%. Partner since 2020-06-29.

merchantRates.conditions: US only; Apple Card with Apple Pay at Mobil-branded pumps (via the Exxon Mobil Rewards+ app or contactless) and attached convenience stores; fuel, convenience store and car wash purchases.
merchantRates.notes: Same terms and exclusions as Exxon. Partner since 2020-06-29.

merchantRates.conditions: Rentals booked on Hertz.com or in the Hertz app, paid with Apple Card via Apple Pay, picked up from and returned to US Hertz CORPORATE locations (franchise locations do not qualify).
merchantRates.notes: Eligible vehicles: cars, SUVs, EVs, minivans, trucks. Excludes: bookings by phone or at the counter, independently licensed franchise locations, rentals over 61 days, cargo vans and box trucks, third-party sites/apps, other Hertz apps or programs (Hertz HZ app, Click&Drive, Car Sales, Rent2Buy, insurance replacement, Business Rewards, Hertz Delivery, government/military, meetings & conventions, Dollar, Thrifty, Hertz Entertainment). With 'Pay Later' the charge posts at pickup and you must still pay with Apple Card via Apple Pay at the counter or you earn nothing extra. Additional Hertz-fulfilled perks via the exclusive link in Wallet > Rewards & Offers: at least 5% off Pay Later base rates, free Emergency Roadside Service, one free additional driver, Loss Damage Waiver at $16.95/day plus tax. Added 2025-11-04.

merchantRates.conditions: US only; Apple Card with Apple Pay at Nike stores, Nike.com, the Nike app, the Nike SNKRS app and Swoosh.com.
merchantRates.notes: Excludes purchases at Nike pop-up events. Nike products bought at other retailers (Foot Locker, Dick's, etc.) earn only the standard rate. Partner since 2019-11-25.

merchantRates.conditions: Apple Card with Apple Pay selected as the payment method in the Uber app or at uber.com; earned on the total amount charged.
merchantRates.notes: Not earned on: alcohol purchases in Oregon, Louisiana, Georgia, Washington, Missouri, Pennsylvania and Massachusetts; Uber gift cards bought in a web browser; transactions where Uber is not the merchant (bike/scooter/car rentals paid to third parties, some liquor/grocery/convenience merchants, third-party apps or affiliates); and purchases where Apple Pay is unavailable, which may include Split Fares, Group Orders, Uber Freight, Uber Family, Uber Teen, Uber Vouchers and Uber Transit. merchantRates.notes: Same exclusions as Uber (alcohol in OR/LA/GA/WA/MO/PA/MA, gift cards, non-Uber merchants, Group Orders where Apple Pay is unavailable). This is Apple Card's only dining/food-delivery bonus since Panera Bread was removed 2025-02-01.

Partner since 2019-09-12.

purchaseProtection.notes: Apple Card carries no Mastercard Purchase Assurance. The Customer Agreement lists no benefits; Apple's official benefits page lists only identity theft protection as a Mastercard benefit; Mastercard's Apple Card benefits page lists no purchase protection.

roadsideAssistance.notes: No card-level roadside benefit. Free Emergency Roadside Service applies only to qualifying Hertz rentals booked through the Apple Card Hertz link (fulfilled by Hertz).

travelEmergencyAssistance.notes: No travel/medical emergency assistance benefit. Mastercard's generic Global Service line (1-800-Mastercard) exists network-wide for lost/stolen card help, but Apple handles Apple Card replacement in Wallet; not documented as an Apple Card benefit.

perks.name: Issuer transition: Goldman Sachs → JPMorgan Chase
perks.details: Issued by Goldman Sachs Bank USA, Salt Lake City Branch (Member FDIC). On 2026-01-07 Apple, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan Chase announced Chase will become the issuer; transition expected to take approximately 24 months from announcement (i.e. around early 2028), subject to closing conditions and regulatory approvals. Goldman Sachs continues to issue and service all accounts until the transition completes. As of 2026-10-02 no closing date, regulatory approval or completion has been announced; the issuer of record is still Goldman Sachs Bank USA and the network stays Mastercard. Apple says Daily Cash (up to 3%), no fees, Apple Card Family, Savings access, ACMI and Wallet management continue; card-number changes 'if any' will be communicated as the date approaches.

perks.name: Mastercard Zero Liability Protection
perks.details: Not liable for unauthorized transactions if you use reasonable care and report promptly. Apple Card additionally uses per-transaction dynamic security codes via Apple Pay, a titanium card with no printed number, and a rotatable virtual card number in Wallet.

perks.name: Mastercard ID Theft Protection
perks.details: Complimentary identity monitoring (surface/dark/deep web) and ID theft resolution specialists (1-877-837-0678), provided by Generali Global Assistance. Requires enrollment at applecard.idprotectiononline.com (live as of 2026-09-28). Listed on Apple's official benefits page as Apple Card's Mastercard benefit.

perks.name: Uber One 6-month free trial
perks.details: Fulfilled by Uber. New or returning Uber One subscribers in the US and Puerto Rico; monthly plan only (not annual); sign up through the exclusive link in Wallet > Rewards & Offers with Apple Card via Apple Pay on file; one per Uber account (each Apple Card Family member can redeem on their own Uber account). Must keep Apple Pay as payment method to receive Uber One benefits. Launched 2025-05-08.

perks.name: Booking.com 2% Travel Credits + Genius Level 2
perks.details: Fulfilled by Booking.com. 2% of eligible prepaid stays/car rentals booked via booking.com/apple-card returned as Booking.com Travel Credits after completion (usable only on future Booking.com bookings); Genius Level 2 status within 24 hours of completing one eligible booking (10-15% discounts, free breakfast/upgrades at select properties). Same rate-type exclusions as the 3% Daily Cash.

perks.name: Hertz rental benefits
perks.details: Fulfilled by Hertz via the exclusive link in Wallet > Rewards & Offers: at least 5% off Pay Later base rates, free Emergency Roadside Service, one free additional driver, Loss Damage Waiver at $16.95/day + tax. US corporate locations, booked on Hertz.com/app; same exclusions as the 3% Daily Cash. Added 2025-11-04.

perks.name: Apple Card Savings (high-yield savings account)
perks.details: Goldman Sachs Bank USA, Member FDIC. 3.50% APY as of 2026-09-23 (variable). No fees, no minimum deposit or balance. Maximum balance $1,000,000 (Deposit Account Agreement effective 2026-03-19); FDIC insurance is the standard $250,000 per depositor. Available to Apple Card Owners and Co-Owners only (not Participants); not available in Guam, Northern Mariana Islands or US Minor Outlying Islands. Opening Savings automatically elects ALL future Daily Cash to Savings (changeable any time). Interest compounds daily, credited monthly. Fund from Apple Cash or a linked bank; external withdrawals take 1-3 business days; transfer limits apply to/from Apple Cash. Apple says Savings access continues through the Chase transition with details to follow. The Wall Street Journal reported (Jan 2026, not confirmed by Apple) that JPMorgan plans to launch a new Apple savings account and existing Goldman Savings customers will choose whether to stay at Goldman or open an account with JPMorgan.

perks.name: Apple Card Family
perks.details: Share one account with up to five others in your Apple Family Sharing group (no familial relationship required): one Co-Owner (18+; jointly and individually liable; reported to bureaus as an owner; two existing cardholders can merge accounts/credit limits subject to credit approval) and Participants (13+; owner can set per-person transaction limits, lock spending, get notifications; Participants 18+ can opt in to be reported as an authorized user to build credit). Everyone earns unlimited Daily Cash on their own purchases, delivered to their own Apple Cash (Participants) or Apple Cash/Savings (Owners/Co-Owners). Continues unchanged through the Chase transition per Apple.

perks.name: Apple Card Monthly Installments (0% APR at Apple)
perks.details: Select ACMI at checkout at Apple Store, apple.com, Apple Store app or 1-800-MY-APPLE. Terms: iPhone 24 months (must choose AT&T, T-Mobile or Verizon; phone is unlocked); iPad, Apple Watch, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, Studio Display and eligible accessories 12 months; Apple TV, AirPods, Beats Flex 6 months. Full 3% Daily Cash on the purchase price is paid up front. Taxes and shipping are charged at your variable APR, not 0%. Not available on refurbished products or via Employee Purchase, business, government, veterans/military storefronts; buying an eligible product with a one-time Apple Card payment (or bundled with non-eligible items) forfeits 0%.

perks.name: No fees of any kind
perks.details: Customer Agreement fee table: Annual Fee None; Transaction Fees None; Penalty Fees None; Other Fees None. No foreign transaction fee (Mastercard performs currency conversion at its rate with no added fee), no late fee, no over-limit fee, no returned-payment fee. Late payments still accrue interest. Cash advances are not permitted at all.

perks.name: Mastercard Travel & Lifestyle Services / Priceless Cities / Priceless Golf / onefinestay 10% off
perks.details: Listed on Mastercard's Apple Card benefits page in its last archived version (2023-02-17). Not mentioned anywhere on Apple's current pages; could not confirm these are still offered to Apple Card holders in 2026. ShopRunner, also listed there, is defunct (shoprunner.com/mastercard returns 404 and the program ended for other issuers in 2025).

cards.acceptance: Mastercard network, accepted worldwide wherever Mastercard is; Apple says Mastercard will remain the network after the Chase transition. Three ways to pay: Apple Pay (2% or 3%), the numberless titanium card (1%), or the virtual card number in Wallet for sites/apps without Apple Pay (1%). NOT usable in Costco US warehouses or Costco gas stations, which accept only Visa credit cards (Costco takes Apple Pay, but the underlying card must be Visa); Costco.com online does accept Mastercard including Apple Card. Card is available only to US residents (Goldman Sachs Bank USA; account managed in Wallet/card.apple.com); Savings not offered in Guam, NMI, US Minor Outlying Islands. The 2% rate depends on Apple Pay acceptance (about 85% of US merchants per Apple); non-contactless terminals and most gas pumps without tap or an app fall to 1%.

cards.name: Discover it Cash Back

currency.name: Cashback Bonus
currency.redemption: Cash back accrues as dollars (Cashback Bonus) and is worth 1 cent per cent everywhere. Redeem in any amount, starting at $0.01, for: statement credit; electronic deposit to any eligible US checking/savings account (presented to your bank within 3 business days); Pay with Cashback Bonus at Amazon.com checkout ($1 rewards = $1; Amazon.com online orders only, some digital goods and Subscribe & Save items excluded; no fee) and at PayPal checkout ($1 Cashback Bonus = $1; eligible online merchants only, not for P2P/sending money, recurring payments, in-store, or non-USD; no fee); and donations to select charities. Gift cards/eCertificates from 100+ brands carry at least 5% added value (5%-20% depending on brand) and require a minimum: $5 on the legacy Discover platform, $25 once the account migrates to Capital One's platform (waves from July 27, 2026 through early 2027). After migration, rewards can no longer be applied toward the minimum payment and Pay with Rewards via Apple Pay is gone, but a new option to redeem against recent purchases is added; automatic-redemption preferences must be re-enrolled. Rewards are earned only when transactions post (1-2 billing periods), never expire for the life of the account, and are paid out by check or credit if the account is closed or unused for 18 months. Cashback Match (first-year) rewards are added within two billing periods after the 365-day match period ends.

earning.conditions: Must activate every quarter (online, mobile app, one-click email link, or 1-800-347-2683). Activation is NOT retroactive: 5% applies from the later of the quarter start or the day you activate. $1,500 is combined across all of that quarter's categories; purchases beyond the cap earn 1%. Transaction date (which for online orders may be the ship date) must fall on or before the last day of the quarter. Rewards post within 2 billing periods.
earning.notes: Discover groups Merchant Category Codes (MCCs) to define each category; a merchant that looks like it fits may not code that way and Discover does not assign MCCs. Purchases through third-party payment accounts, mobile/wireless card readers, or digital wallets may not earn if Discover does not receive enough transaction detail. No earning on cash advances, balance transfers, the portion of a purchase paid with rewards, transfers from deposit accounts, illegal transactions, or Cash at Checkout. See `rotating.quarters` for the 2026 schedule and Discover's per-quarter fine print. Categories announced roughly one month before each quarter (about Dec 1, Mar 1, Jun 1, Sep 1) and activation opens on the announcement date.

earning.conditions: Unlimited; automatic.
earning.notes: Applies to all purchases that are not that quarter's Program Purchases and to rotating-category spend beyond the $1,500 cap or before activation.

quarters.notes: Grocery Stores, Wholesale Clubs and Select Streaming Services. Discover fine print (via Doctor of Credit/FinanceBuzz quoting the activation page): grocery purchases include supermarkets, meat lockers, bakeries, smaller grocery stores and grocery delivery services; convenience stores and discount stores may not qualify; ALL purchases at Walmart and Target are not eligible (supercenters/superstores excluded). Wholesale clubs: confirm your Discover card is accepted (Costco does not accept Discover in-store or online; Sam's Club and BJ's do); affiliated club services such as travel, cell-phone and delivery, and individual merchants/stand-alone stores inside club locations, may not be eligible. Select streaming services per Discover's list: Amazon Music, Amazon Prime Video, AMC+, Apple Music, Apple TV, Audible, DirecTV Stream, Fandango at Home, Google Play Music and Video, Max, iHeartRadio, MLB.TV, Netflix, Pandora, Paramount Plus, Peacock, SiriusXM, Sling TV, Spotify, Starz, YouTube Music, YouTube Premium, YouTube TV; subscriptions bundled with another product or billed through a third party (cable/internet/telecom) and separately billed add-ons do not qualify. Announced Nov 30/Dec 1, 2025.

Restaurants and Home Improvement Stores. Discover fine print: 'Purchases at or with full-service restaurants, cafes, cafeterias, fast-food locations and caterers. Note, bakeries and restaurants located inside of or affiliated with another business may not qualify.' Home improvement: 'Earn on online and in-store purchases at home improvement retail stores, building supply stores, home furnishing stores, home appliance stores and floor covering stores. Lawn, nursery and garden supply stores also count toward category earnings.' Purchases paid to third-party contractors do not count (FinanceBuzz). Announced Feb 28/Mar 1, 2026.

Gas Stations & EV Charging, Transportation (airlines and public transit) and Drugstores. Discover fine print (via Doctor of Credit quoting the activation page): 'Gas stations & EV charging affiliated with supermarkets, supercenters, and wholesale clubs may not be eligible.' Transportation includes airlines and commuter services (bus, train, ferry); 'Car rentals, cruise lines, taxi & rideshare services (including shared bikes and scooters), limousines, parking garages and toll-related purchases are not included.' 'Purchases made through travel agencies, travel aggregator sites or other third-party booking services may not qualify' (book airfare directly with the airline). Drugstores: 'Pharmacies inside of other retail stores may not qualify.' First time airlines appeared in a Discover calendar. Announced May 31/Jun 1, 2026. (CardRatings' page listing 'home improvement' for Q3 is an error; every other source and DoC's verbatim terms agree on the categories above.)

Restaurants, Entertainment and Utilities (activation opened Sep 1, 2026; activate any time through Dec 31, 2026). Discover fine print (via Doctor of Credit, CNBC Select, NerdWallet): Restaurants: 'Restaurant purchases include those made at merchants classified as full-service restaurants, cafes, cafeterias, fast-food locations, and caterers. Restaurants located inside of or affiliated with another business, such as hotels or retail stores, and establishments classified as a bakery may not qualify.' Entertainment: 'ticket purchases at movie theaters, sports promoters (professional and semi-professional live events), theatrical promoters, concert promoters, amusement parks, tourist attractions, aquariums, zoos, dance halls, record stores, video rental locations, pool halls and bowling alleys. Tickets for or fees at golf courses, country clubs, some collegiate sporting events, charitable events, as well as cable and digital streaming and subscription services, amusement park tickets purchased on third-party sites, and entertainment and resort packages categorized as travel or hotel do not qualify.' Utilities: 'residential electricity, natural gas, and water service ... purchases made over the phone or online for internet, cable, satellite TV, and mobile and landline phone service. Purchases at physical retail stores for internet, cable, satellite, and mobile and landline phone service do not qualify'; payments through third parties (landlord/property-management), home fuel delivery, standalone streaming services, some satellite phone and internet service, vehicle connectivity, and accessories or equipment may not qualify. First time Entertainment and Utilities have appeared in a Discover calendar. Video-game stores/digital game platforms are not in Discover's Entertainment MCC list, and memberships such as Uber One are not restaurant purchases; streaming subscriptions are explicitly excluded from both Entertainment and Utilities (hence the canonical exclusions). Still activatable through Dec 31, 2026, but 5% applies only from the activation date. Re-checked 2026-10-02: no change to Q4 categories or terms.

cards.acceptance: US: Discover says it is accepted at 99% of places that take credit cards nationwide (Feb 2026 Nilson Report, cited on the official card page). Key exception is Costco: warehouses and gas stations are Visa-only (since 2016) and Costco.com dropped Discover on Nov 15, 2023, so a Discover card cannot earn the wholesale-club bonus at Costco at all (Sam's Club and BJ's do accept it). Internationally the Discover Global Network (Discover Network, Diners Club International, PULSE and about 30 alliance partners including JCB in Japan, UnionPay in China, RuPay in India, Elo in Brazil, BC Card in Korea, Troy in Turkey, mada in Saudi Arabia, Prosa in Mexico) claims 185+ countries and territories, but practical acceptance is far thinner than Visa/Mastercard outside the US, Japan, China, India and tourist areas of Mexico/Caribbean; it is patchy in Western Europe (better in Germany/Spain/Greece, weak in France/Italy/Ireland), weak in Canada and South America, and largely absent in Africa and Russia. Carry a Visa/Mastercard backup abroad. No foreign transaction fee; conversions use a government or interbank rate chosen by the issuer. The Capital One acquisition (closed May 18, 2025) did not change the network: Discover it cards remain Discover-branded on the Discover Network (Capital One's FAQ: card brand and network unchanged). Separately, Capital One is moving its own debit cards and some Capital One-branded credit cards (Venture, VentureOne, Savor, SavorOne, Quicksilver, QuicksilverOne) onto the Discover Network, which adds volume to the network but does not change where a Discover it card works.

gotchas: Activation is not retroactive. Unlike Chase Freedom, Discover pays 5% only from the day you activate; activate on the 1st (or when the email arrives ~1 month early) every quarter.
The $1,500 cap is combined across all of the quarter's categories, not per category. Max bonus is $60 extra ($75 total) per quarter; heavy spenders should move spend to another card after $1,500.

Walmart and Target never count as grocery stores; supercenter- and warehouse-club-affiliated gas stations and EV chargers may not count as gas; pharmacies inside other stores (e.g., Target/Walmart/Kroger pharmacies) may not count as drugstores; restaurants inside hotels/retail stores and anything coded as a bakery may not count as restaurants.
Costco does not accept Discover anywhere (in-store, gas, or Costco.com), so wholesale-club quarters only work at Sam's Club, BJ's, etc.

Q3 2026 'Transportation' excludes taxis, rideshare, bike/scooter share, parking garages, tolls, limos, car rentals and cruises; airfare via OTAs/aggregators may not qualify - book directly with the airline.

Q4 2026 'Utilities' must be paid online or by phone directly to the provider; in-store carrier payments, rent-bundled utilities via a landlord/property manager, and standalone streaming do not qualify. 'Entertainment' excludes golf/country clubs, streaming subscriptions and third-party ticket sites.
Streaming must be billed directly by an eligible service; bundles billed by a cable/telecom company, app-store-billed subscriptions billed through a third party, and add-ons may not qualify.
Digital wallets/third-party payment processors can strip merchant detail; if Discover cannot see the MCC, the purchase earns 1% (or nothing).

Rewards post 1-2 billing periods after the transaction; the Cashback Match posts within two billing periods after your first 365 days, so you will not see it exactly on your anniversary. Rewards earned but processed after the 365-day window are not matched.
Cashback Match is only for brand-new accounts; product changes and existing cardholders do not get it. Redeeming during year one does not reduce the match.

After migration to Capital One, gift cards require $25 minimum (was $5), rewards cannot cover the minimum payment, and Pay with Rewards via Apple Pay is gone; auto-redemption must be set up again. Whether your account has migrated determines which rules apply.

No purchase protection, extended warranty, return/price protection, rental-car coverage, travel insurance or cell-phone protection - all ended in 2018. Use another card for big-ticket or travel purchases where protection matters.
Discover acceptance abroad is spotty (especially Western Europe, Canada, South America); no FX fee is irrelevant if the card is declined. Register travel in the app and carry a Visa/Mastercard.
